verses.en: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
verses.fr: Après avoir autrefois, à plusieurs reprises et de plusieurs manières, parlé à nos pères par les prophètes, Dieu,
verses.am: ከጥንት ጀምሮ እግዚአብሔር በብዙ ዓይነትና በብዙ ጎዳና ለአባቶቻችን በነቢያት ተናግሮ፥

verses.en: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
verses.fr: dans ces derniers temps, nous a parlé par le Fils, qu''il a établi héritier de toutes choses, par lequel il a aussi créé le monde,
verses.am: ሁሉን ወራሽ ባደረገው ደግሞም ዓለማትን በፈጠረበት በልጁ በዚህ ዘመን መጨረሻ ለእኛ ተናገረን፤

verses.en: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high:
verses.fr: et qui, étant le reflet de sa gloire et l''empreinte de sa personne, et soutenant toutes choses par sa parole puissante, a fait la purification des péchés et s''est assis à la droite de la majesté divine dans les lieux très hauts,
verses.am: እርሱም የክብሩ መንጸባረቅና የባሕርዩ ምሳሌ ሆኖ፥ ሁሉን በስልጣኑ ቃል እየደገፈ፥ ኃጢአታችንን በራሱ ካነጻ በኋላ በሰማያት በግርማው ቀኝ ተቀመጠ፤

verses.en: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
verses.fr: devenu d''autant supérieur aux anges qu''il a hérité d''un nom plus excellent que le leur.
verses.am: ከመላእክት ይልቅ እጅግ የሚበልጥ ስምን በወረሰ መጠን እንዲሁ ከእነርሱ አብዝቶ ይበልጣል።

verses.en: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
verses.fr: Car auquel des anges Dieu a-t-il jamais dit: Tu es mon Fils, Je t''ai engendré aujourd''hui? Et encore: Je serai pour lui un père, et il sera pour moi un fils?
verses.am: ከመላእክትስ። አንተ ልጄ ነህ፥ እኔ ዛሬ ወልጄሃለሁ፥ ደግሞም። እኔ አባት እሆነዋለሁ እርሱም ልጅ ይሆነኛል

verses.en: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.
verses.fr: Et lorsqu''il introduit de nouveau dans le monde le premier-né, il dit: Que tous les anges de Dieu l''adorent!
verses.am: ያለው ከቶ ለማን ነው? ደግሞም በኵርን ወደ ዓለም ሲያገባ። የእግዚአብሔር መላእክት ሁሉም ለእርሱ ይስገዱ ይላል።

verses.en: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
verses.fr: De plus, il dit des anges: Celui qui fait de ses anges des vents, Et de ses serviteurs une flamme de feu.
verses.am: ስለ መላእክትም። መላእክቱን መናፍስት አገልጋዮቹንም የእሳት ነበልባል የሚያደርግ

verses.en: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
verses.fr: Mais il a dit au Fils: Ton trône, ô Dieu, est éternel; Le sceptre de ton règne est un sceptre d''équité;
verses.am: ይላል፤ ስለ ልጁ ግን። አምላክ ሆይ፥ ዙፋንህ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ይኖራል፤ የመንግሥትህ በትር የቅንነት በትር ነው።

verses.en: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.fr: Tu as aimé la justice, et tu as haï l''iniquité; C''est pourquoi, ô Dieu, ton Dieu t''a oint D''une huile de joie au-dessus de tes égaux.
verses.am: ጽድቅን ወደድህ ዓመፅንም ጠላህ፤ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ ከጓደኞችህ ይልቅ በደስታ ዘይት ቀባህ

verses.en: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:
verses.fr: Et encore: Toi, Seigneur, tu as au commencement fondé la terre, Et les cieux sont l''ouvrage de tes mains;
verses.am: ይላል። ደግሞ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ከጥንት ምድርን መሠረትህ፥ ሰማዮችም የእጆችህ ሥራ ናቸው፤

verses.en: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
verses.fr: Ils périront, mais tu subsistes; Ils vieilliront tous comme un vêtement,
verses.am: እነርሱም ይጠፋሉ አንተ ግን ጸንተህ ትኖራለህ፤ ሁሉም እንደ ልብስ ያረጃሉ፥

verses.en: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
verses.fr: Tu les rouleras comme un manteau et ils seront changés; Mais toi, tu restes le même, Et tes années ne finiront point.
verses.am: እንደ መጎናጸፊያም ትጠቀልላቸዋለህ ይለወጡማል፤ አንተ ግን አንተ ነህ፥ ዓመቶችህም ከቶ አያልቁም

verses.en: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?
verses.fr: Et auquel des anges a-t-il jamais dit: Assieds-toi à ma droite, jusqu''à ce que je fasse de tes ennemis ton marchepied?
verses.am: ይላል። ነገር ግን ከመላእክት። ጠላቶችህን የእግርህ መረገጫ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ በቀኜ ተቀመጥ

verses.en: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
verses.fr: Ne sont-ils pas tous des esprits au service de Dieu, envoyés pour exercer un ministère en faveur de ceux qui doivent hériter du salut?
verses.am: ከቶ ለማን ብሎአል? ሁሉ መዳንን ይወርሱ ዘንድ ስላላቸው ለማገዝ የሚላኩ የሚያገለግሉም መናፍስት አይደሉምን?

verses.en: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi nous devons d''autant plus nous attacher aux choses que nous avons entendues, de peur que nous ne soyons emportés loin d''elles.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከሰማነው ነገር ምናልባት እንዳንወሰድ፥ ለእርሱ አብልጠን ልንጠነቀቅ ያስፈልገናል።

verses.en: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;
verses.fr: Car, si la parole annoncée par des anges a eu son effet, et si toute transgression et toute désobéissance a reçu une juste rétribution,
verses.am: በመላእክት የተነገረው ቃል ጽኑ ከሆነ፥ መተላለፍና አለመታዘዝም ሁሉ የጽድቅን ብድራት ከተቀበለ፥ እኛስ እንዲህ ያለውን ታላቅ መዳን ቸል ብንለው፥ እንዴት እናመልጣለን?

verses.en: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;
verses.fr: comment échapperons-nous en négligeant un si grand salut, qui, annoncé d''abord par le Seigneur, nous a été confirmé par ceux qui l''ont entendu,
verses.am: ይህ በጌታ በመጀመሪያ የተነገረ ነበርና፥ የሰሙትም ለእኛ አጸኑት፥

verses.en: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?
verses.fr: Dieu appuyant leur témoignage par des signes, des prodiges, et divers miracles, et par les dons du Saint-Esprit distribués selon sa volonté.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እርሱ ራሱ እንደ ፈቀደ በምልክትና በድንቅ ነገር በልዩ ልዩ ተአምራትም፥ መንፈስ ቅዱስንም በማደል አብሮ መሰከረለት።

verses.en: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
verses.fr: En effet, ce n''est pas à des anges que Dieu a soumis le monde à venir dont nous parlons.
verses.am: ስለ እርሱ የምንናገርበትን የሚመጣውን ዓለም ለመላእክት ያስገዛው አይደለምና።

verses.en: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man that thou visitest him?
verses.fr: Or quelqu''un a rendu quelque part ce témoignage: Qu''est-ce que l''homme, pour que tu te souviennes de lui, Ou le fils de l''homme, pour que tu prennes soin de lui?
verses.am: ነገር ግን አንዱ በአንድ ስፍራ። ታስበው ዘንድ ሰው ምንድር ነው? ወይስ ትጎበኘው ዘንድ የሰው ልጅ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:
verses.fr: Tu l''as abaissé pour un peu de temps au-dessous des anges, Tu l''as couronné de gloire et d''honneur,
verses.am: ከመላእክት ይልቅ በጥቂት አሳነስኸው፤ የክብርና የምስጋና ዘውድ ጫንህለት፥ በእጆችህም ሥራ ላይ ሾምኸው፤

verses.en: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.
verses.fr: Tu as mis toutes choses sous ses pieds. En effet, en lui soumettant toutes choses, Dieu n''a rien laissé qui ne lui fût soumis. Cependant, nous ne voyons pas encore maintenant que toutes choses lui soient soumises.
verses.am: ሁሉን ከእግሮቹ በታች አስገዛህለት ብሎ መሰከረ። ሁሉን ከእርሱ በታች ባስገዛ ጊዜ ያልተገዛለት ምንም አልተወምና። አሁን ግን ሁሉ እንደ ተገዛለት ገና አናይም፤

verses.en: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.
verses.fr: Mais celui qui a été abaissé pour un peu de temps au-dessous des anges, Jésus, nous le voyons couronné de gloire et d''honneur à cause de la mort qu''il a soufferte, afin que, par la grâce de Dieu, il souffrît la mort pour tous.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ስለ ሰው ሁሉ ሞትን ይቀምስ ዘንድ፥ ከመላእክት ይልቅ በጥቂት አንሶ የነበረውን ኢየሱስን ከሞት መከራ የተነሣ የክብርና የምስጋናን ዘውድ ተጭኖ እናየዋለን።

verses.en: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
verses.fr: Il convenait, en effet, que celui pour qui et par qui sont toutes choses, et qui voulait conduire à la gloire beaucoup de fils, élevât à la perfection par les souffrances le Prince de leur salut.
verses.am: ብዙ ልጆችን ወደ ክብር ሲያመጣ የመዳናቸውን ራስ በመከራ ይፈጽም ዘንድ፥ ከእርሱ የተነሣ ሁሉ በእርሱም ሁሉ ለሆነ፥ ለእርሱ ተገብቶታልና።

verses.en: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
verses.fr: Car celui qui sanctifie et ceux qui sont sanctifiés sont tous issus d''un seul. C''est pourquoi il n''a pas honte de les appeler frères,
verses.am: ስለዚህም ምክንያት። ስምህን ለወንድሞቼ እነግራቸዋለሁ በማኅበርም መካከል በዜማ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ ደግሞም። እኔ በእርሱ እታመናለሁ፤ ደግሞም። እነሆኝ እኔን እግዚአብሔር የሰጠኝንም ልጆች ሲል ወንድሞች ብሎ ሊጠራቸው አያፍርም።

verses.en: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.fr: lorsqu''il dit: J''annoncerai ton nom à mes frères, Je te célébrerai au milieu de l''assemblée.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ምክንያት። ስምህን ለወንድሞቼ እነግራቸዋለሁ በማኅበርም መካከል በዜማ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ ደግሞም። እኔ በእርሱ እታመናለሁ፤ ደግሞም። እነሆኝ እኔን እግዚአብሔር የሰጠኝንም ልጆች ሲል ወንድሞች ብሎ ሊጠራቸው አያፍርም።

verses.en: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.
verses.fr: Et encore: Je me confierai en toi. Et encore: Me voici, moi et les enfants que Dieu m''a donnés.
verses.am: የአብርሃምን ዘር ይዞአል እንጂ የያዘው የመላእክትን አይደለም።

verses.en: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
verses.fr: Ainsi donc, puisque les enfants participent au sang et à la chair, il y a également participé lui-même, afin que, par la mort, il anéantît celui qui a la puissance de la mort, c''est-à-dire le diable,
verses.am: የአብርሃምን ዘር ይዞአል እንጂ የያዘው የመላእክትን አይደለም።

verses.en: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
verses.fr: et qu''il délivrât tous ceux qui, par crainte de la mort, étaient toute leur vie retenus dans la servitude.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የሕዝብን ኃጢአት ለማስተስረይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር በሆነው ነገር ሁሉ የሚምርና የታመነ ሊቀ ካህናት እንዲሆን፥ በነገር ሁሉ ወንድሞቹን ሊመስል ተገባው።

verses.en: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
verses.fr: Car assurément ce n''est pas à des anges qu''il vient en aide, mais c''est à la postérité d''Abraham.
verses.am: እርሱ ራሱ ተፈትኖ መከራን ስለ ተቀበለ የሚፈተኑትን ሊረዳቸው ይችላልና።

verses.en: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
verses.fr: En conséquence, il a dû être rendu semblable en toutes choses à ses frères, afin qu''il fût un souverain sacrificateur miséricordieux et fidèle dans le service de Dieu, pour faire l''expiation des péchés du peuple;
verses.am: ስለዚህ የሕዝብን ኃጢአት ለማስተስረይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር በሆነው ነገር ሁሉ የሚምርና የታመነ ሊቀ ካህናት እንዲሆን፥ በነገር ሁሉ ወንድሞቹን ሊመስል ተገባው።

verses.en: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
verses.fr: car, ayant été tenté lui-même dans ce qu''il a souffert, il peut secourir ceux qui sont tentés.
verses.am: እርሱ ራሱ ተፈትኖ መከራን ስለ ተቀበለ የሚፈተኑትን ሊረዳቸው ይችላልና።

verses.en: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, frères saints, qui avez part à la vocation céleste, considérez l''apôtre et le souverain sacrificateur de la foi que nous professons,
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ ከሰማያዊው ጥሪ ተካፋዮች የሆናችሁ ቅዱሳን ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ የሃይማኖታችንን ሐዋርያና ሊቀ ካህናት ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ተመልከቱ፤

verses.en: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
verses.fr: Jésus, qui a été fidèle à celui qui l''a établi, comme le fut Moïse dans toute sa maison.
verses.am: ሙሴ ደግሞ በቤቱ ሁሉ የታመነ እንደሆነ፥ እርሱ ለሾመው የታመነ ነበረ።

verses.en: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
verses.fr: Car il a été jugé digne d''une gloire d''autant supérieure à celle de Moïse que celui qui a construit une maison a plus d''honneur que la maison même.
verses.am: ቤትን የሚያዘጋጀው ከቤቱ ይልቅ የሚበልጥ ክብር እንዳለው መጠን፥ እንዲሁ እርሱ ከሙሴ ይልቅ የሚበልጥ ክብር የተገባው ሆኖ ተቆጥሮአልና።

verses.en: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.
verses.fr: Chaque maison est construite par quelqu''un, mais celui qui a construit toutes choses, c''est Dieu.
verses.am: እያንዳንዱ ቤት በአንድ ሰው ተዘጋጅቶአልና፥ ሁሉን ያዘጋጀ ግን እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
verses.fr: Pour Moïse, il a été fidèle dans toute la maison de Dieu, comme serviteur, pour rendre témoignage de ce qui devait être annoncé;
verses.am: ሙሴስ በኋላ ስለሚነገረው ነገር ምስክር ሊሆን በቤቱ ሁሉ እንደ ሎሌ የታመነ ነበረ፥ ክርስቶስ ግን እንደ ልጅ በቤቱ ላይ የታመነ ነው፤

verses.en: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
verses.fr: mais Christ l''est comme Fils sur sa maison; et sa maison, c''est nous, pourvu que nous retenions jusqu''à la fin la ferme confiance et l''espérance dont nous nous glorifions.
verses.am: እኛም የምንደፍርበትን የምንመካበትንም ተስፋ እስከ መጨረሻው አጽንተን ብንጠብቅ ቤቱ ነን።

verses.en: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, selon ce que dit le Saint-Esprit: Aujourd''hui, si vous entendez sa voix,
verses.am: ስለዚህ መንፈስ ቅዱስ እንደሚል።

verses.en: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.fr: N''endurcissez pas vos coeurs, comme lors de la révolte, Le jour de la tentation dans le désert,

verses.en: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
verses.fr: Où vos pères me tentèrent Pour m''éprouver, et ils virent mes oeuvres Pendant quarante ans.
verses.am: ዛሬ ድምፁን ብትሰሙት፥ አባቶቻችሁ እኔን የፈተኑበት የመረመሩበትም አርባ ዓመትም ሥራዬን ያዩበት በምድረ በዳ በፈተና ቀን በማስመረር እንደ ሆነ፥ ልባችሁን እልከኛ አታድርጉ።

verses.en: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
verses.fr: Aussi je fus irrité contre cette génération, et je dis: Ils ont toujours un coeur qui s''égare. Ils n''ont pas connu mes voies.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ያን ትውልድ ተቆጥቼ። ዘወትር በልባቸው ይስታሉ መንገዴን ግን አላወቁም አልሁ፤

verses.en: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
verses.fr: Je jurai donc dans ma colère: Ils n''entreront pas dans mon repos!
verses.am: እንዲሁ። ወደ ዕረፍቴ አይገቡም ብዬ በቍጣዬ ማልሁ።

verses.en: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
verses.fr: Prenez garde, frères, que quelqu''un de vous n''ait un coeur mauvais et incrédule, au point de se détourner du Dieu vivant.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ምናልባት ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን የሚያስክዳችሁ ክፉና የማያምን ልብ ከእናንተ በአንዳችሁ እንዳይኖር ተጠንቀቁ፤

verses.en: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.fr: Mais exhortez-vous les uns les autres chaque jour, aussi longtemps qu''on peut dire: Aujourd''hui! afin qu''aucun de vous ne s''endurcisse par la séduction du péché.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከእናንተ ማንም በኃጢአት መታለል እልከኛ እንዳይሆን፥ ዛሬ ተብሎ ሲጠራ ሳለ፥ በእያንዳንዱ ቀን እርስ በርሳችሁ ተመካከሩ፤

verses.en: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
verses.fr: Car nous sommes devenus participants de Christ, pourvu que nous retenions fermement jusqu''à la fin l''assurance que nous avions au commencement,
verses.am: የመጀመሪያ እምነታችንን እስከ መጨረሻው አጽንተን ብንጠብቅ፥ የክርስቶስ ተካፋዮች ሆነናልና፤

verses.en: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
verses.fr: pendant qu''il est dit: Aujourd''hui, si vous entendez sa voix, N''endurcissez pas vos coeurs, comme lors de la révolte.
verses.am: እየተባለ። ዛሬ ድምጹን ብትሰሙት፥ በማስመረር እንደሆነ ልባችሁን እልከኛ አታድርጉ።

verses.en: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
verses.fr: Qui furent, en effet, ceux qui se révoltèrent après l''avoir entendue, sinon tous ceux qui étaient sortis d''Egypte sous la conduite de Moïse?
verses.am: ሰምተው ያስመረሩት እነማን ነበሩ? በሙሴ ተመርተው ከግብጽ የወጡ ሁሉ አይደሉምን?

verses.en: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
verses.fr: Et contre qui Dieu fut-il irrité pendant quarante ans, sinon contre ceux qui péchaient, et dont les cadavres tombèrent dans le désert?
verses.am: አርባ አመትም የተቆጣባቸው እነማን ነበሩ? ሬሳቸው በምድረ በዳ የወደቀ፥ ኃጢአትን ያደረጉት እነርሱ አይደሉምን?

verses.en: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
verses.fr: Et à qui jura-t-il qu''ils n''entreraient pas dans son repos, sinon à ceux qui avaient désobéi?
verses.am: ካልታዘዙትም በቀር ወደ እረፍቱ እንዳይገቡ የማለባቸው እነማን ነበሩ?

verses.en: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
verses.fr: Aussi voyons-nous qu''ils ne purent y entrer à cause de leur incrédulité.
verses.am: ባለማመናቸውም ጠንቅ ሊገቡ እንዳልተቻላቸው እናያለን።

verses.en: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
verses.fr: Craignons donc, tandis que la promesse d''entrer dans son repos subsiste encore, qu''aucun de vous ne paraisse être venu trop tard.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ወደ ዕረፍቱ ለመግባት ተስፋ ገና ቀርቶልን ከሆነ፥ ምናልባት ከእናንተ ማንም የማይበቃ መስሎ እንዳይታይ እንፍራ።

verses.en: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
verses.fr: Car cette bonne nouvelle nous a été annoncée aussi bien qu''à eux; mais la parole qui leur fut annoncée ne leur servit de rien, parce qu''elle ne trouva pas de la foi chez ceux qui l''entendirent.
verses.am: ለእነዚያ ደግሞ እንደ ተነገረ ለእኛ የምስራች ተሰብኮልናልና፤ ዳሩ ግን የሰሙት ቃል ከሰሚዎቹ ጋር በእምነት ስላልተዋሐደ አልጠቀማቸውም።

verses.en: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.fr: Pour nous qui avons cru, nous entrons dans le repos, selon qu''il dit: Je jurai dans ma colère: Ils n''entreront pas dans mon repos! Il dit cela, quoique ses oeuvres eussent été achevées depuis la création du monde.
verses.am: ሥራው ዓለም ከተፈጠረ ጀምሮ ምንም እንኳ ቢፈጸም። እንዲህ። ወደ ዕረፍቴ አይገቡም ብዬ በቁጣዬ ማልሁ እንዳለ፥ እኛስ ያመንን ወደ ዕረፍቱ እንገባለን።

verses.en: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
verses.fr: Car il a parlé quelque part ainsi du septième jour: Et Dieu se reposa de toutes ses oeuvres le septième jour.
verses.am: ስለ ሰባተኛው ቀን በአንድ ስፍራ። እግዚአብሔርም በሰባተኛው ቀን ከሥራው ሁሉ ዐረፈ ብሎአልና፤

verses.en: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
verses.fr: Et ici encore: Ils n''entreront pas dans mon repos!
verses.am: በዚህ ስፍራም ደግሞ። ወደ ዕረፍቴ አይገቡም።

verses.en: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
verses.fr: Or, puisqu''il est encore réservé à quelques-uns d''y entrer, et que ceux à qui d''abord la promesse a été faite n''y sont pas entrés à cause de leur désobéissance,
verses.am: እንግዲህ አንዳንዶች በዚያ እንዲገቡ ስለ ቀሩ፥ ቀድሞም የምስራች የተሰበከላቸው ባለመታዘዝ ጠንቅ ስላልገቡ።

verses.en: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
verses.fr: Dieu fixe de nouveau un jour-aujourd''hui-en disant dans David si longtemps après, comme il est dit plus haut: Aujourd''hui, si vous entendez sa voix, N''endurcissez pas vos coeurs.
verses.am: ዛሬ ድምፁን ብትሰሙት ልባችሁን እልከኛ አታድርጉ በፊት እንደ ተባለ፥ ይህን ከሚያህል ዘመን በኋላ በዳዊት ሲናገር። ዛሬ ብሎ አንድ ቀን እንደ ገና ይቀጥራል።

verses.en: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
verses.fr: Car, si Josué leur eût donné le repos, il ne parlerait pas après cela d''un autre jour.
verses.am: ኢያሱ አሳርፎአቸው ኖሮ ቢሆንስ፥ ከዚያ በኋላ ስለ ሌላ ቀን ባልተናገረ ነበር።

verses.en: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
verses.fr: Il y a donc un repos de sabbat réservé au peuple de Dieu.
verses.am: እንግዲያስ የሰንበት ዕረፍት ለእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ቀርቶላቸዋል።

verses.en: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
verses.fr: Car celui qui entre dans le repos de Dieu se repose de ses oeuvres, comme Dieu s''est reposé des siennes.
verses.am: ወደ ዕረፍቱ የገባ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከሥራው እንዳረፈ፥ እርሱ ደግሞ ከሥራው አርፎአልና።

verses.en: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
verses.fr: Efforçons-nous donc d''entrer dans ce repos, afin que personne ne tombe en donnant le même exemple de désobéissance.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንደዚያ እንደ አለመታዘዝ ምሳሌ ማንም እንዳይወድቅ ወደዚያ ዕረፍት ለመግባት እንትጋ።

verses.en: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verses.fr: Car la parole de Dieu est vivante et efficace, plus tranchante qu''une épée quelconque à deux tranchants, pénétrante jusqu''à partager âme et esprit, jointures et moelles; elle juge les sentiments et les pensées du coeur.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሕያው ነውና፥ የሚሠራም፥ ሁለትም አፍ ካለው ሰይፍ ሁሉ ይልቅ የተሳለ ነው፥ ነፍስንና መንፈስንም ጅማትንና ቅልጥምንም እስኪለይ ድረስ ይወጋል፥ የልብንም ስሜትና አሳብ ይመረምራል፤

verses.en: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
verses.fr: Nulle créature n''est cachée devant lui, mais tout est à nu et à découvert aux yeux de celui à qui nous devons rendre compte.
verses.am: እኛን በሚቆጣጠር በእርሱ ዓይኖቹ ፊት ሁሉ ነገር የተራቆተና የተገለጠ ነው እንጂ፥ በእርሱ ፊት የተሰወረ ፍጥረት የለም።

verses.en: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.
verses.fr: Ainsi, puisque nous avons un grand souverain sacrificateur qui a traversé les cieux, Jésus, le Fils de Dieu, demeurons fermes dans la foi que nous professons.
verses.am: እንግዲህ በሰማያት ያለፈ ትልቅ ሊቀ ካህናት የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ኢየሱስ ስላለን፥ ጸንተን ሃይማኖታችንን እንጠብቅ።

verses.en: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
verses.fr: Car nous n''avons pas un souverain sacrificateur qui ne puisse compatir à nos faiblesses; au contraire, il a été tenté comme nous en toutes choses, sans commettre de péché.
verses.am: ከኃጢአት በቀር በነገር ሁሉ እንደ እኛ የተፈተነ ነው እንጂ፥ በድካማችን ሊራራልን የማይችል ሊቀ ካህናት የለንም።

verses.en: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
verses.fr: Approchons-nous donc avec assurance du trône de la grâce, afin d''obtenir miséricorde et de trouver grâce, pour être secourus dans nos besoins.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምሕረትን እንድንቀበል በሚያስፈልገንም ጊዜ የሚረዳንን ጸጋ እንድናገኝ ወደ ጸጋው ዙፋን በእምነት እንቅረብ።

verses.en: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
verses.fr: En effet, tout souverain sacrificateur pris du milieu des hommes est établi pour les hommes dans le service de Dieu, afin de présenter des offrandes et des sacrifices pour les péchés.
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናት ሁሉ ስለ ኃጢአት መባንና መስዋዕትን ሊያቀርብ ከሰው ተመርጦ ለእግዚአብሔር በሆነው ነገር ሁሉ ስለ ሰው ይሾማልና፤

verses.en: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
verses.fr: Il peut être indulgent pour les ignorants et les égarés, puisque la faiblesse est aussi son partage.
verses.am: እርሱ ራሱም ደግሞ ድካምን ስለሚለብስ፥ ላልተማሩትና ለሚስቱት ሊራራላቸው ይችላል፤

verses.en: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
verses.fr: Et c''est à cause de cette faiblesse qu''il doit offrir des sacrifices pour ses propres péchés, comme pour ceux du peuple.
verses.am: በዚህም ምክንያት ስለ ሕዝብ እንደሚያቀርብ እንዲሁ ስለ ራሱ ደግሞ መስዋዕትን ስለ ኃጢአት ሊያቀርብ ይገባዋል።

verses.en: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
verses.fr: Nul ne s''attribue cette dignité, s''il n''est appelé de Dieu, comme le fut Aaron.
verses.am: እንደ አሮንም በእግዚአብሔር ከተጠራ በቀር ማንም ክብሩን ለራሱ የሚወስድ የለም።

verses.en: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.
verses.fr: Et Christ ne s''est pas non plus attribué la gloire de devenir souverain sacrificateur, mais il la tient de celui qui lui a dit: Tu es mon Fils, Je t''ai engendré aujourd''hui!
verses.am: እንዲሁ ክርስቶስ ደግሞ ሊቀ ካህናት ሊሆን ራሱን አላከበረም ነገር ግን። አንተ ልጄ ነህ እኔ ዛሬ ወልጄሃለሁ ያለው እርሱ ነው፤

verses.en: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.fr: Comme il dit encore ailleurs: Tu es sacrificateur pour toujours, Selon l''ordre de Melchisédek.
verses.am: እንደዚህም በሌላ ስፍራ ደግሞ። አንተ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ለዘላለም ካህን ነህ ይላል።

verses.en: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
verses.fr: C''est lui qui, dans les jours de sa chair, ayant présenté avec de grands cris et avec larmes des prières et des supplications à celui qui pouvait le sauver de la mort, et ayant été exaucé à cause de sa piété,
verses.am: እርሱም በስጋው ወራት ከሞት ሊያድነው ወደሚችል ከብርቱ ጩኸትና ከእንባ ጋር ጸሎትንና ምልጃን አቀረበ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ስለ መፍራቱ ተሰማለት፤

verses.en: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
verses.fr: a appris, bien qu''il fût Fils, l''obéissance par les choses qu''il a souffertes,
verses.am: ምንም ልጅ ቢሆን፥ ከተቀበለው መከራ መታዘዝን ተማረ፤

verses.en: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
verses.fr: et qui, après avoir été élevé à la perfection, est devenu pour tous ceux qui lui obéissent l''auteur d''un salut éternel,
verses.am: ስለ እርሱም የምንናገረው ብዙ ነገር አለን፥ ጆሮቻችሁም ስለ ፈዘዙ በቃል ልንተረጕመው ጭንቅ ነው።

verses.en: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.fr: Dieu l''ayant déclaré souverain sacrificateur selon l''ordre de Melchisédek.
verses.am: ስለ እርሱም የምንናገረው ብዙ ነገር አለን፥ ጆሮቻችሁም ስለ ፈዘዙ በቃል ልንተረጕመው ጭንቅ ነው።

verses.en: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
verses.fr: Nous avons beaucoup à dire là-dessus, et des choses difficiles à expliquer, parce que vous êtes devenus lents à comprendre.
verses.am: ከጊዜው የተነሳ አስተማሪዎች ልትሆኑ ሲገባችሁ፥ አንድ ሰው ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቃላት መጀመሪያ ያለውን የሕፃንነትን ትምህርት እንዲያስተምራችሁ እንደ ገና ያስፈልጋችኋልና፤ የሚያስፈልጋችሁም ወተት ነው እንጂ ጠንካራ ምግብ አይደለም።

verses.en: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
verses.fr: Vous, en effet, qui depuis longtemps devriez être des maîtres, vous avez encore besoin qu''on vous enseigne les premiers rudiments des oracles de Dieu, vous en êtes venus à avoir besoin de lait et non d''une nourriture solide.
verses.am: ወተት የሚጋት ሁሉ ሕፃን ስለ ሆነ የጽድቅን ቃል አያውቅምና፤

verses.en: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
verses.fr: Or, quiconque en est au lait n''a pas l''expérience de la parole de justice; car il est un enfant.
verses.am: ጠንካራ ምግብ ግን መልካሙንና ክፉውን ለመለየት በስራቸው የለመደ ልቡና ላላቸው ለፍጹማን ሰዎች ነው።

verses.en: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
verses.fr: Mais la nourriture solide est pour les hommes faits, pour ceux dont le jugement est exercé par l''usage à discerner ce qui est bien et ce qui est mal.
verses.am: ጠንካራ ምግብ ግን መልካሙንና ክፉውን ለመለየት በስራቸው የለመደ ልቡና ላላቸው ለፍጹማን ሰዎች ነው።

verses.en: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, laissant les éléments de la parole de Christ, tendons à ce qui est parfait, sans poser de nouveau le fondement du renoncement aux oeuvres mortes, de la foi en Dieu,
verses.am: ስለዚህ የክርስቶስን ነገር መጀመሪያ የሚናገረውን ቃል ትተን ወደ ፍጻሜ እንሂድ፤ መሠረትን ደግመን አንመሥርት፥

verses.en: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
verses.fr: de la doctrine des baptêmes, de l''imposition des mains, de la résurrection des morts, et du jugement éternel.
verses.am: እርሱም ከሞተ ሥራ ንስሐና በእግዚአብሔር እምነት፥ ስለ ጥምቀቶችና እጆችንም ስለ መጫን ስለ ሙታንም ትንሣኤ ስለ ዘላለም ፍርድም ትምህርት ነው።

verses.en: And this will we do, if God permit.
verses.fr: C''est ce que nous ferons, si Dieu le permet.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ቢፈቅድ ይህን እናደርጋለን።

verses.en: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
verses.fr: Car il est impossible que ceux qui ont été une fois éclairés, qui ont goûté le don céleste, qui ont eu part au Saint-Esprit,
verses.am: አንድ ጊዜ ብርሃን የበራላቸውን ሰማያዊውንም ስጦታ የቀመሱትን ከመንፈስ ቅዱስም ተካፋዮች ሆነው የነበሩትን

verses.en: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,
verses.fr: qui ont goûté la bonne parole de Dieu et les puissances du siècle à venir,
verses.am: መልካሙንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃልና ሊመጣ ያለውን የዓለም ኃይል የቀመሱትን

verses.en: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.
verses.fr: et qui sont tombés, soient encore renouvelés et amenés à la repentance, puisqu''ils crucifient pour leur part le Fils de Dieu et l''exposent à l''ignominie.
verses.am: በኋላም የካዱትን እንደገና ለንስሐ እነርሱን ማደስ የማይቻል ነው፤ ለራሳቸው የእግዚአብሔርን ልጅ ይሰቅሉታልና ያዋርዱትማልና።

verses.en: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:
verses.fr: Lorsqu''une terre est abreuvée par la pluie qui tombe souvent sur elle, et qu''elle produit une herbe utile à ceux pour qui elle est cultivée, elle participe à la bénédiction de Dieu;
verses.am: ብዙ ጊዜ በእርስዋ ላይ የሚወርደውን ዝናብ የምትጠጣ መሬት፥ ለሚያርሱአትም ደግሞ የምትጠቅምን አትክልት የምታበቅል፥ ከእግዚአብሔር በረከትን ታገኛለችና፤

verses.en: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.
verses.fr: mais, si elle produit des épines et des chardons, elle est réprouvée et près d''être maudite, et on finit par y mettre le feu.
verses.am: እሾህና ኵርንችትን ግን ብታወጣ፥ የተጣለች ናት ለመረገምም ትቀርባለች፥ መጨረሻዋም መቃጠል ነው።

verses.en: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
verses.fr: Quoique nous parlions ainsi, bien-aimés, nous attendons, pour ce qui vous concerne, des choses meilleures et favorables au salut.
verses.am: ስለ እናንተ ግን፥ ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ምንም እንኳ እንዲሁ ብንናገር፥ አብልጦ የሚሻለውና ለመዳን የሚሆነው እንዲሆንላችሁ ተረድተናል።

verses.en: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
verses.fr: Car Dieu n''est pas injuste, pour oublier votre travail et l''amour que vous avez montré pour son nom, ayant rendu et rendant encore des services aux saints.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር፥ ቅዱሳንን ስላገለገላችሁ እስከ አሁንም ስለምታገለግሉአቸው፥ ያደረጋችሁትን ሥራ ለስሙም ያሳያችሁትን ፍቅር ይረሳ ዘንድ ዓመፀኛ አይደለምና።

verses.en: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
verses.fr: Nous désirons que chacun de vous montre le même zèle pour conserver jusqu''à la fin une pleine espérance,
verses.am: እንዲሁም እርሱ ከታገሰ በኋላ ተስፋውን አገኘ።

verses.en: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
verses.fr: en sorte que vous ne vous relâchiez point, et que vous imitiez ceux qui, par la foi et la persévérance, héritent des promesses.
verses.am: እንዲሁም እርሱ ከታገሰ በኋላ ተስፋውን አገኘ።

verses.en: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
verses.fr: Lorsque Dieu fit la promesse à Abraham, ne pouvant jurer par un plus grand que lui, il jura par lui-même,
verses.am: እንዲሁም እርሱ ከታገሰ በኋላ ተስፋውን አገኘ።

verses.en: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
verses.fr: et dit: Certainement je te bénirai et je multiplierai ta postérité.
verses.am: ሰዎች ከእነርሱ በሚበልጠው ይምላሉና፥ ለማስረዳትም የሆነው መሐላ የሙግት ሁሉ ፍጻሜ ይሆናል፤

verses.en: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
verses.fr: Et c''est ainsi qu''Abraham, ayant persévéré, obtint l''effet de la promesse.
verses.am: ይህም ተስፋ እንደ ነፍስ መልሕቅ አለን እርሱም እርግጥና ጽኑ የሆነ ወደ መጋረጃውም ውስጥ የገባ ነው፤

verses.en: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.
verses.fr: Or les hommes jurent par celui qui est plus grand qu''eux, et le serment est une garantie qui met fin à tous leurs différends.
verses.am: ይህም ተስፋ እንደ ነፍስ መልሕቅ አለን እርሱም እርግጥና ጽኑ የሆነ ወደ መጋረጃውም ውስጥ የገባ ነው፤

verses.en: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi Dieu, voulant montrer avec plus d''évidence aux héritiers de la promesse l''immutabilité de sa résolution, intervint par un serment,
verses.am: በዚያም ኢየሱስ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ለዘላለም ሊቀ ካህናት የሆነው፥ ስለ እኛ ቀዳሚ ሆኖ ገባ።

verses.en: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
verses.fr: afin que, par deux choses immuables, dans lesquelles il est impossible que Dieu mente, nous trouvions un puissant encouragement, nous dont le seul refuge a été de saisir l''espérance qui nous était proposée.
verses.am: ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር፥ የተስፋውን ቃል ለሚወርሱ ፈቃዱ እንደ ማይለወጥ አብልጦ ሊያሳያቸው ስለ ፈቀደ፥ እግዚአብሔር ሊዋሽ በማይቻል በሁለት በማይለወጥ ነገር፥ በፊታችን ያለውን ተስፋ ለመያዝ ለሸሸን ለእኛ ብርቱ መጽናናት ይሆንልን ዘንድ፥ በመሓላ በመካከል ገባ፤

verses.en: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
verses.fr: Cette espérance, nous la possédons comme une ancre de l''âme, sûre et solide; elle pénètre au delà du voile,
verses.am: ይህም ተስፋ እንደ ነፍስ መልሕቅ አለን እርሱም እርግጥና ጽኑ የሆነ ወደ መጋረጃውም ውስጥ የገባ ነው፤

verses.en: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.fr: là où Jésus est entré pour nous comme précurseur, ayant été fait souverain sacrificateur pour toujours, selon l''ordre de Melchisédek.
verses.am: በዚያም ኢየሱስ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ለዘላለም ሊቀ ካህናት የሆነው፥ ስለ እኛ ቀዳሚ ሆኖ ገባ።

verses.en: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
verses.fr: En effet, ce Melchisédek, roi de Salem, sacrificateur du Dieu Très-Haut, -qui alla au-devant d''Abraham lorsqu''il revenait de la défaite des rois, qui le bénit,
verses.am: የሳሌም ንጉሥና የልዑል እግዚአብሔር ካህን የሆነ ይህ መልከ ጼዴቅ አብርሃም ነገሥታትን ገድሎ ሲመለስ ከእርሱ ጋር ተገናኝቶ ባረከው፤

verses.en: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
verses.fr: et à qui Abraham donna la dîme de tout, -qui est d''abord roi de justice, d''après la signification de son nom, ensuite roi de Salem, c''est-à-dire roi de paix, -
verses.am: ለእርሱም ደግሞ አብርሃም ከሁሉ አስራትን አካፈለው። የስሙም ትርጓሜ በመጀመሪያ የጽድቅ ንጉሥ ነው፥ ኋላም ደግሞ የሳሌም ንጉሥ ማለት የሰላም ንጉሥ ነው።

verses.en: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.
verses.fr: qui est sans père, sans mère, sans généalogie, qui n''a ni commencement de jours ni fin de vie, -mais qui est rendu semblable au Fils de Dieu, -ce Melchisédek demeure sacrificateur à perpétuité.
verses.am: አባትና እናት የትውልድም ቍጥር የሉትም፥ ለዘመኑም ጥንት ለህይወቱም ፍጻሜ የለውም፥ ዳሩ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ተመስሎ ለዘላለም ካህን ሆኖ ይኖራል።

verses.en: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
verses.fr: Considérez combien est grand celui auquel le patriarche Abraham donna la dîme du butin.
verses.am: የአባቶች አለቃ አብርሃም ከዘረፋው የሚሻለውን አስራት የሰጠው ይህ ሰው እንዴት ትልቅ እንደ ነበረ እስኪ ተመልከቱ።

verses.en: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
verses.fr: Ceux des fils de Lévi qui exercent le sacerdoce ont, d''après la loi, l''ordre de lever la dîme sur le peuple, c''est-à-dire, sur leurs frères, qui cependant sont issus des reins d''Abraham;
verses.am: ከሌዊ ልጆችም ክህነትን የሚቀበሉት ከህዝቡ ማለት ከወንድሞቻቸው፥ እነርሱ ምንም ከአብርሃም ወገብ ቢወጡ፥ ከእነርሱ አሥራትን በሕግ እንዲያስወጡ ትእዛዝ አላቸው፤

verses.en: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
verses.fr: et lui, qui ne tirait pas d''eux son origine, il leva la dîme sur Abraham, et il bénit celui qui avait les promesses.
verses.am: ትውልዱ ከእነርሱ የማይቈጠረው ግን ከአብርሃም አሥራትን አውጥቶአል፥ የተስፋ ቃል የነበረውንም ባርኮአል።

verses.en: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
verses.fr: Or c''est sans contredit l''inférieur qui est béni par le supérieur.
verses.am: ትንሹም በታላቁ እንዲባረክ ክርክር የሌለበት ነገር ነው።

verses.en: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.
verses.fr: Et ici, ceux qui perçoivent la dîme sont des hommes mortels; mais là, c''est celui dont il est attesté qu''il est vivant.
verses.am: በዚህስ የሚሞቱ ሰዎች አሥራትን ያስወጣሉ፥ በዚያ ግን የሚያስወጣ በሕይወት እንዲኖር የተመሰከረለት እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
verses.fr: De plus, Lévi, qui perçoit la dîme, l''a payée, pour ainsi dire, par Abraham;
verses.am: ይህንም ለማለት ሲፈቀድ፥ አሥራትን የሚያስወጣ ሌዊ እንኳ በአብርሃም እጅ አሥራትን ሰጥቶአል፤

verses.en: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
verses.fr: car il était encore dans les reins de son père, lorsque Melchisédek alla au-devant d''Abraham.
verses.am: መልከ ጼዴቅ በተገናኘው ጊዜ ገና በአባቱ ወገብ ነበረና።

verses.en: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
verses.fr: Si donc la perfection avait été possible par le sacerdoce Lévitique, -car c''est sur ce sacerdoce que repose la loi donnée au peuple, -qu''était-il encore besoin qu''il parût un autre sacrificateur selon l''ordre de Melchisédek, et non selon l''ordre d''Aaron?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ህዝቡ በሌዊ ክህነት የተመሠረተን ሕግ ተቀብለዋልና በዚያ ክህነት ፍጹምነት የተገኘ ቢሆን፥ እንደ አሮን ሹመት የማይቈጠር፥ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ግን የሆነ ሌላ ካህን ሊነሳ ወደፊት ስለ ምን ያስፈልጋል?

verses.en: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
verses.fr: Car, le sacerdoce étant changé, nécessairement aussi il y a un changement de loi.
verses.am: ክህነቱ ሲለወጥ፥ ሕጉ ደግሞ ሊለወጥ የግድ ነውና።

verses.en: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
verses.fr: En effet, celui de qui ces choses sont dites appartient à une autre tribu, dont aucun membre n''a fait le service de l''autel;
verses.am: ይህ ነገር የተነገረለት እርሱ በሌላ ወገን ተካፍሎአልና፥ ከዚያም መሠዊያውን ያገለገለ ማንም የለም፤

verses.en: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
verses.fr: car il est notoire que notre Seigneur est sorti de Juda, tribu dont Moïse n''a rien dit pour ce qui concerne le sacerdoce.
verses.am: ጌታችን ከይሁዳ ነገድ እንደወጣ የተገለጠ ነውና፥ ስለዚህም ነገድ ሙሴ ምንም እንኳ ስለ ክህነት አልተናገረም።

verses.en: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
verses.fr: Cela devient plus évident encore, quand il paraît un autre sacrificateur à la ressemblance de Melchisédek,
verses.am: አንተ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ለዘላለም ካህን ነህ ብሎ ይመሰክራልና።

verses.en: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
verses.fr: institué, non d''après la loi d''une ordonnance charnelle, mais selon la puissance d''une vie impérissable;
verses.am: አንተ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ለዘላለም ካህን ነህ ብሎ ይመሰክራልና።

verses.en: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.fr: car ce témoignage lui est rendu: Tu es sacrificateur pour toujours Selon l''ordre de Melchisédek.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ኢየሱስ ለሚሻል ኪዳን ዋስ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
verses.fr: Il y a ainsi abolition d''une ordonnance antérieure, à cause de son impuissance et de son inutilité, -
verses.am: እንዲሁ ኢየሱስ ለሚሻል ኪዳን ዋስ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
verses.fr: car la loi n''a rien amené à la perfection, -et introduction d''une meilleure espérance, par laquelle nous nous approchons de Dieu.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ኢየሱስ ለሚሻል ኪዳን ዋስ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
verses.fr: Et, comme cela n''a pas eu lieu sans serment,
verses.am: እነርሱም እንዳይኖሩ ሞት ስለ ከለከላቸው ካህናት የሆኑት ብዙ ናቸው፤

verses.en: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
verses.fr: car, tandis que les Lévites sont devenus sacrificateurs sans serment, Jésus l''est devenu avec serment par celui qui lui a dit: Le Seigneur a juré, et il ne se repentira pas: Tu es sacrificateur pour toujours, Selon l''ordre de Melchisédek. -
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ለዘላለም የሚኖር ስለሆነ የማይለወጥ ክህነት አለው፤

verses.en: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
verses.fr: Jésus est par cela même le garant d''une alliance plus excellente.
verses.am: ስለ እነርሱም ሊያማልድ ዘወትር በሕይወት ይኖራልና ስለዚህ ደግሞ በእርሱ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚመጡትን ፈጽሞ ሊያድናቸው ይችላል።

verses.en: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
verses.fr: De plus, il y a eu des sacrificateurs en grand nombre, parce que la mort les empêchait d''être permanents.
verses.am: ቅዱስና ያለ ተንኮል ነውርም የሌለበት ከኃጢአተኞችም የተለየ ከሰማያትም ከፍ ከፍ ያለ፥ እንደዚህ ያለ ሊቀ ካህናት ይገባልና፤

verses.en: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
verses.fr: Mais lui, parce qu''il demeure éternellement, possède un sacerdoce qui n''est pas transmissible.
verses.am: እርሱም እንደነዚያ ሊቃነ ካህናት አስቀድሞ ስለ ራሱ ኃጢአት በኋላም ስለ ሕዝቡ ኃጢአት ዕለት ዕለት መሥዋዕትን ሊያቀርብ አያስፈልገውም፤ ራሱን ባቀረበ ጊዜ ይህን አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ አድርጎአልና።

verses.en: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
verses.fr: C''est aussi pour cela qu''il peut sauver parfaitement ceux qui s''approchent de Dieu par lui, étant toujours vivant pour intercéder en leur faveur.
verses.am: ሕጉ ድካም ያላቸውን ሰዎች ሊቀ ካህናት አድርጎ ይሾማልና፤ ከሕግ በኋላ የመጣ የመሐላው ቃል ግን ለዘላለም ፍጹም የሆነውን ልጅ ይሾማል።

verses.en: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
verses.fr: Il nous convenait, en effet, d''avoir un souverain sacrificateur comme lui, saint, innocent, sans tache, séparé des pécheurs, et plus élevé que les cieux,
verses.am: ቅዱስና ያለ ተንኮል ነውርም የሌለበት ከኃጢአተኞችም የተለየ ከሰማያትም ከፍ ከፍ ያለ፥ እንደዚህ ያለ ሊቀ ካህናት ይገባልና፤

verses.en: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
verses.fr: qui n''a pas besoin, comme les souverains sacrificateurs, d''offrir chaque jour des sacrifices, d''abord pour ses propres péchés, ensuite pour ceux du peuple, -car ceci, il l''a fait une fois pour toutes en s''offrant lui-même.
verses.am: እርሱም እንደነዚያ ሊቃነ ካህናት አስቀድሞ ስለ ራሱ ኃጢአት በኋላም ስለ ሕዝቡ ኃጢአት ዕለት ዕለት መሥዋዕትን ሊያቀርብ አያስፈልገውም፤ ራሱን ባቀረበ ጊዜ ይህን አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ አድርጎአልና።

verses.en: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
verses.fr: En effet, la loi établit souverains sacrificateurs des hommes sujets à la faiblesse; mais la parole du serment qui a été fait après la loi établit le Fils, qui est parfait pour l''éternité.
verses.am: ሕጉ ድካም ያላቸውን ሰዎች ሊቀ ካህናት አድርጎ ይሾማልና፤ ከሕግ በኋላ የመጣ የመሐላው ቃል ግን ለዘላለም ፍጹም የሆነውን ልጅ ይሾማል።

verses.en: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;
verses.fr: Le point capital de ce qui vient d''être dit, c''est que nous avons un tel souverain sacrificateur, qui s''est assis à la droite du trône de la majesté divine dans les cieux,
verses.am: ከተናገርነውም ዋና ነገሩ ይህ ነው፤ በሰማያት በግርማው ዙፋን ቀኝ የተቀመጠ እንዲህ ያለ ሊቀ ካህናት አለን፤

verses.en: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.
verses.fr: comme ministre du sanctuaire et du véritable tabernacle, qui a été dressé par le Seigneur et non par un homme.
verses.am: እርሱም የመቅደስና የእውነተኛይቱ ድንኳን አገልጋይ ነው፥ እርስዋም በሰው ሳይሆን በጌታ የተተከለች ናት።

verses.en: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
verses.fr: Tout souverain sacrificateur est établi pour présenter des offrandes et des sacrifices; d''où il est nécessaire que celui-ci ait aussi quelque chose à présenter.
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናት ሁሉ መባንና መሥዋዕትን ሊያቀርብ ይሾማልና፤ ስለዚህም ለዚህ ደግሞ የሚያቀርበው አንዳች ሊኖረው የግድ ነው።

verses.en: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:
verses.fr: S''il était sur la terre, il ne serait pas même sacrificateur, puisque là sont ceux qui présentent les offrandes selon la loi
verses.am: እንግዲህ በምድር ቢኖርስ፥ እንደ ሕግ መባን የሚያቀርቡት ስላሉ፥ ካህን እንኳ ባልሆነም፤

verses.en: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.
verses.fr: lesquels célèbrent un culte, image et ombre des choses célestes, selon que Moïse en fut divinement averti lorsqu''il allait construire le tabernacle: Aie soin, lui fut-il dit, de faire tout d''après le modèle qui t''a été montré sur la montagne.
verses.am: እነርሱም ሙሴ ድንኳኒቱን ሊሠራ ሳለ እንደ ተረዳ፥ ለሰማያዊ ነገር ምሳሌና ጥላ የሚሆነውን ያገለግላሉ። በተራራው እንደ ተገለጠልህ ምሳሌ ሁሉን ታደርግ ዘንድ ተጠንቀቅ ብሎት ነበርና።

verses.en: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.
verses.fr: Mais maintenant il a obtenu un ministère d''autant supérieur qu''il est le médiateur d''une alliance plus excellente, qui a été établie sur de meilleures promesses.
verses.am: አሁን ግን በሚሻል ተስፋ ቃል በተመሠረተ በሚሻል ኪዳን ደግሞ መካከለኛ እንደሚሆን በዚያ ልክ እጅግ የሚሻል አገልግሎት አግኝቶአል።

verses.en: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.
verses.fr: En effet, si la première alliance avait été sans défaut, il n''aurait pas été question de la remplacer par une seconde.
verses.am: ፊተኛው ኪዳን ነቀፋ ባይኖረው፥ ለሁለተኛው ስፍራ ባልተፈለገም ነበር።

verses.en: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:
verses.fr: Car c''est avec l''expression d''un blâme que le Seigneur dit à Israël: Voici, les jours viennent, dit le Seigneur, Où je ferai avec la maison d''Israël et la maison de Juda Une alliance nouvelle,
verses.am: እነርሱን እየነቀፈ ይላቸዋልና። እነሆ፥ ከእስራኤል ቤትና ከይሁዳ ቤት ጋር አዲስ ኪዳን የምገባበት ወራት ይመጣል ይላል ጌታ፤

verses.en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Non comme l''alliance que je traitai avec leurs pères, Le jour où je les saisis par la main Pour les faire sortir du pays d''Egypte; Car ils n''ont pas persévéré dans mon alliance, Et moi aussi je ne me suis pas soucié d''eux, dit le Seigneur.
verses.am: ከግብፅ አገር አወጣቸው ዘንድ እጃቸውን በያዝሁበት ቀን ከአባቶቻቸው ጋር እንደገባሁት ኪዳን አይደለም፤ እነርሱ በኪዳኔ አልጸኑምና፥ እኔም ቸል አልኋቸው ይላል ጌታ።

verses.en: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:
verses.fr: Mais voici l''alliance que je ferai avec la maison d''Israël, Après ces jours-là, dit le Seigneur: Je mettrai mes lois dans leur esprit, Je les écrirai dans leur coeur; Et je serai leur Dieu, Et ils seront mon peuple.
verses.am: ከዚያ ወራት በኋላ ከእስራኤል ቤት ጋር የምገባው ቃል ኪዳን ይህ ነውና ይላል ጌታ፤ ሕጌን በልቡናቸው አኖራለሁ በልባቸውም እጽፈዋለሁ፥ እኔም አምላክ እሆንላቸዋለሁ እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑልኛል።

verses.en: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
verses.fr: Aucun n''enseignera plus son concitoyen, Ni aucun son frère, en disant: Connais le Seigneur! Car tous me connaîtront, Depuis le plus petit jusqu''au plus grand d''entre eux;
verses.am: እያንዳንዱም ጐረቤቱን እያንዳንዱም ወንድሙን። ጌታን እወቅ ብሎ አያስተምርም ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ሁሉ ያውቁኛልና።

verses.en: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.fr: Parce que je pardonnerai leurs iniquités, Et que je ne me souviendrai plus de leurs péchés.
verses.am: ዓመፃቸውን እምራቸዋለሁና፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ደግሜ አላስብም።

verses.en: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.
verses.fr: En disant: une alliance nouvelle, il a déclaré la première ancienne; or, ce qui est ancien, ce qui a vieilli, est près de disparaître.
verses.am: አዲስ በማለቱ ፊተኛውን አስረጅቶአል፤ አሮጌና ውራጅ የሆነውስ ሊጠፋ ቀርቦአል።

verses.en: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
verses.fr: La première alliance avait aussi des ordonnances relatives au culte, et le sanctuaire terrestre.
verses.am: ፊተኛይቱም ደግሞ የአገልግሎት ስርዓትና የዚህ ዓለም የሆነው መቅደስ ነበራት።

verses.en: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.
verses.fr: Un tabernacle fut, en effet, construit. Dans la partie antérieure, appelée le lieu saint, étaient le chandelier, la table, et les pains de proposition.
verses.am: የመጀመሪያይቱ ድንኳን ተዘጋጅታ ነበርና፥ በእርስዋም ቅድስት በምትባለው ውስጥ መቅረዙና ጠረጴዛው የመስዋዕቱም ኅብስት ነበረባት፤

verses.en: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;
verses.fr: Derrière le second voile se trouvait la partie du tabernacle appelée le saint des saints,
verses.am: ከሁለተኛውም መጋረጃ ወዲያ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን የምትባለው ድንኳን ነበረች፥

verses.en: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
verses.fr: renfermant l''autel d''or pour les parfums, et l''arche de l''alliance, entièrement recouverte d''or. Il y avait dans l''arche un vase d''or contenant la manne, la verge d''Aaron, qui avait fleuri, et les tables de l''alliance.
verses.am: በዚያም ውስጥ የወርቅ ማዕጠንት ነበረ ሁለንተናዋም በወርቅ የተለበጠች የኪዳን ታቦት፤ በእርስዋም ውስጥ መና ያለባት የወርቅ መሶብና የበቀለች የአሮን በትር የኪዳኑም ጽላት ነበሩ፥

verses.en: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.
verses.fr: Au-dessus de l''arche étaient les chérubins de la gloire, couvrant de leur ombre le propitiatoire. Ce n''est pas le moment de parler en détail là-dessus.
verses.am: በላይዋም ማስተስሪያውን የሚጋርዱ የክብር ኪሩቤል ነበሩ፤ ስለ እነዚህም ስለ እያንዳንዳቸው ልንናገር አሁን አንችልም።

verses.en: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.
verses.fr: Or, ces choses étant ainsi disposées, les sacrificateurs qui font le service entrent en tout temps dans la première partie du tabernacle;
verses.am: ይህም እንደዚህ ተዘጋጅቶ ሳለ፥ ካህናት አገልግሎታቸውን እየፈጸሙ ዘወትር በፊተኛይቱ ድንኳን ይገቡባታል፤

verses.en: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:
verses.fr: et dans la seconde le souverain sacrificateur seul entre une fois par an, non sans y porter du sang qu''il offre pour lui-même et pour les péchés du peuple.
verses.am: በሁለተኛይቱ ግን ሊቀ ካህናት ብቻውን በዓመት አንድ ጊዜ ይገባባታል፥ እርሱም ሰለ ራሱና ስለ ሕዝቡ ስሕተት የሚያቀርበውን ደም ሳይዝ አይገባም፤

verses.en: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
verses.fr: Le Saint-Esprit montrait par là que le chemin du lieu très saint n''était pas encore ouvert, tant que le premier tabernacle subsistait.
verses.am: ፊተኛይቱም ድንኳን በዚህ ገና ቆማ ሳለች፥ ወደ ቅድስት የሚወስደው መንገድ ገና እንዳልተገለጠ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ያሳያል።

verses.en: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;
verses.fr: C''est une figure pour le temps actuel, où l''on présente des offrandes et des sacrifices qui ne peuvent rendre parfait sous le rapport de la conscience celui qui rend ce culte,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ክርስቶስ ይመጣ ዘንድ ላለው መልካም ነገር ሊቀ ካህናት ሆኖ፥ በምትበልጠውና በምትሻለው በእጆችም ባልተሠራች ማለት ለዚህ ፍጥረት ባልሆነች ድንኳን፥

verses.en: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.
verses.fr: et qui, avec les aliments, les boissons et les diverses ablutions, étaient des ordonnances charnelles imposées seulement jusqu''à une époque de réformation.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ክርስቶስ ይመጣ ዘንድ ላለው መልካም ነገር ሊቀ ካህናት ሆኖ፥ በምትበልጠውና በምትሻለው በእጆችም ባልተሠራች ማለት ለዚህ ፍጥረት ባልሆነች ድንኳን፥

verses.en: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;
verses.fr: Mais Christ est venu comme souverain sacrificateur des biens à venir; il a traversé le tabernacle plus grand et plus parfait, qui n''est pas construit de main d''homme, c''est-à-dire, qui n''est pas de cette création;
verses.am: የዘላለምን ቤዛነት አግኝቶ አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ ወደ ቅድስት በገዛ ደሙ ገባ እንጂ በፍየሎችና በጥጆች ደም አይደለም።

verses.en: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
verses.fr: et il est entré une fois pour toutes dans le lieu très saint, non avec le sang des boucs et des veaux, mais avec son propre sang, ayant obtenu une rédemption éternelle.
verses.am: የኮርማዎችና የፍየሎች ደም በረከሱትም ላይ የተረጨ የጊደር አመድ ሥጋን ለማንጻት የሚቀድሱ ከሆኑ፥

verses.en: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:
verses.fr: Car si le sang des taureaux et des boucs, et la cendre d''une vache, répandue sur ceux qui sont souillés, sanctifient et procurent la pureté de la chair,
verses.am: ነውር የሌለው ሆኖ በዘላለም መንፈስ ራሱን ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀረበ የክርስቶስ ደም እንዴት ይልቅ ሕያውን እግዚአብሔርን ልታመልኩ ከሞተ ሥራ ሕሊናችሁን ያነጻ ይሆን?

verses.en: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
verses.fr: combien plus le sang de Christ, qui, par un esprit éternel, s''est offert lui-même sans tache à Dieu, purifiera-t-il votre conscience des oeuvres mortes, afin que vous serviez le Dieu vivant!
verses.am: ስለዚህም የፊተኛው ኪዳን ሲጸና ሕግን የተላለፉትን የሚቤዥ ሞት ስለ ሆነ፥ የተጠሩት የዘላለምን ርስት የተስፋ ቃል እንዲቀበሉ እርሱ የአዲስ ኪዳን መካከለኛ ነው።

verses.en: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
verses.fr: Et c''est pour cela qu''il est le médiateur d''une nouvelle alliance, afin que, la mort étant intervenue pour le rachat des transgressions commises sous la première alliance, ceux qui ont été appelés reçoivent l''héritage éternel qui leur a été promis.
verses.am: ኑዛዜ ያለ እንደሆነ የተናዛዡን ሞት ማርዳት የግድ ነውና፤

verses.en: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
verses.fr: Car là où il y a un testament, il est nécessaire que la mort du testateur soit constatée.
verses.am: ሰው ሲሞት ኑዛዜው ይጸናልና፥ ተናዛዡ በሕይወት ሲኖር ግን ከቶ አይጠቅምም።

verses.en: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.
verses.fr: Un testament, en effet, n''est valable qu''en cas de mort, puisqu''il n''a aucune force tant que le testateur vit.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ፊተኛው ኪዳን እንኳ ያለ ደም አልተመረቀም።

verses.en: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
verses.fr: Voilà pourquoi c''est avec du sang que même la première alliance fut inaugurée.
verses.am: እንዲሁም በድንኳኒቱና በማገልገያው ዕቃ ሁሉ ደምን ረጨ።

verses.en: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,
verses.fr: Moïse, après avoir prononcé devant tout le peuple tous les commandements de la loi, prit le sang des veaux et des boucs, avec de l''eau, de la laine écarlate, et de l''hysope; et il fit l''aspersion sur le livre lui-même et sur tout le peuple,
verses.am: እንዲሁም በድንኳኒቱና በማገልገያው ዕቃ ሁሉ ደምን ረጨ።

verses.en: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.
verses.fr: en disant: Ceci est le sang de l''alliance que Dieu a ordonnée pour vous.
verses.am: እንደ ሕጉም ከጥቂቶች በቀር ነገር ሁሉ በደም ይነጻል፥ ደምም ሳይፈስ ስርየት የለም።

verses.en: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.
verses.fr: Il fit pareillement l''aspersion avec le sang sur le tabernacle et sur tous les ustensiles du culte.
verses.am: እንግዲህ በሰማያት ያሉትን የሚመስለው ነገር በዚህ ሊነጻ እንጂ በሰማያት ያሉቱ ራሳቸው ከእርሱ ይልቅ በሚበልጥ መስዋዕት ሊነጹ የግድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
verses.fr: Et presque tout, d''après la loi, est purifié avec du sang, et sans effusion de sang il n''y a pas de pardon.
verses.am: ክርስቶስ በእጅ ወደ ተሰራች፥ የእውነተኛይቱ ምሳሌ ወደ ምትሆን ቅድስት አልገባምና፥ ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ስለ እኛ አሁን ይታይ ዘንድ ወደ እርስዋ ወደ ሰማይ ገባ።

verses.en: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.fr: Il était donc nécessaire, puisque les images des choses qui sont dans les cieux devaient être purifiées de cette manière, que les choses célestes elles-mêmes le fussent par des sacrifices plus excellents que ceux-là.
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናትም በየዓመቱ የሌላውን ደም ይዞ ወደ ቅድስት እንደሚገባ፥ ራሱን ብዙ ጊዜ ሊያቀርብ አልገባም፤

verses.en: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:
verses.fr: Car Christ n''est pas entré dans un sanctuaire fait de main d''homme, en imitation du véritable, mais il est entré dans le ciel même, afin de comparaître maintenant pour nous devant la face de Dieu.
verses.am: እንዲህ ቢሆንስ፥ ዓለም ከተፈጠረ ጀምሮ ብዙ ጊዜ መከራ ሊቀበል ባስፈለገው ነበር፤ አሁን ግን በዓለም ፍጻሜ ራሱን በመሠዋት ኃጢአትን ሊሽር አንድ ጊዜ ተገልጦአል።

verses.en: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;
verses.fr: Et ce n''est pas pour s''offrir lui-même plusieurs fois qu''il y est entré, comme le souverain sacrificateur entre chaque année dans le sanctuaire avec du sang étranger;
verses.am: ለሰዎችም አንድ ጊዜ መሞት ከእርሱ በኋላም ፍርድ እንደ ተመደበባቸው፥

verses.en: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
verses.fr: autrement, il aurait fallu qu''il eût souffert plusieurs fois depuis la création du monde, tandis que maintenant, à la fin des siècles, il a paru une seule fois pour abolir le péché par son sacrifice.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ክርስቶስ ደግሞ፥ የብዙዎችን ኃጢአት ሊሸከም አንድ ጊዜ ከተሰዋ በኋላ፥ ያድናቸው ዘንድ ለሚጠባበቁት ሁለተኛ ጊዜ ያለ ኃጢአት ይታይላቸዋል።

verses.en: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
verses.fr: Et comme il est réservé aux hommes de mourir une seule fois, après quoi vient le jugement,
verses.am: ለሰዎችም አንድ ጊዜ መሞት ከእርሱ በኋላም ፍርድ እንደ ተመደበባቸው፥

verses.en: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.
verses.fr: de même Christ, qui s''est offert une seule fois pour porter les péchés de plusieurs, apparaîtra sans péché une seconde fois à ceux qui l''attendent pour leur salut.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ክርስቶስ ደግሞ፥ የብዙዎችን ኃጢአት ሊሸከም አንድ ጊዜ ከተሰዋ በኋላ፥ ያድናቸው ዘንድ ለሚጠባበቁት ሁለተኛ ጊዜ ያለ ኃጢአት ይታይላቸዋል።

verses.en: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
verses.fr: En effet, la loi, qui possède une ombre des biens à venir, et non l''exacte représentation des choses, ne peut jamais, par les mêmes sacrifices qu''on offre perpétuellement chaque année, amener les assistants à la perfection.
verses.am: ሕጉ ሊመጣ ያለው የበጎ ነገር እውነተኛ አምሳል ሳይሆን የነገር ጥላ አለውና፥ ስለዚህም በየዓመቱ ዘወትር በሚያቀርቡት በዚያ መሥዋዕት የሚቀርቡትን ሊፈጽም ከቶ አይችልም።

verses.en: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
verses.fr: Autrement, n''aurait-on pas cessé de les offrir, parce que ceux qui rendent ce culte, étant une fois purifiés, n''auraient plus eu aucune conscience de leurs péchés?
verses.am: እንደዚህማ ባይሆን፥ የሚያመልኩት አንድ ጊዜ ነጽተው ከዚያ በኋላ በሕሊናቸው ኃጢአትን ስላላወቁ ማቅረብን በተዉ አልነበረምን?

verses.en: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.
verses.fr: Mais le souvenir des péchés est renouvelé chaque année par ces sacrifices;
verses.am: ነገር ግን በዚያ መሥዋዕት በየዓመቱ የኃጢአት መታሰቢያ አለ፤

verses.en: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
verses.fr: car il est impossible que le sang des taureaux et des boucs ôte les péchés.
verses.am: የኮርማዎችና የፍየሎች ደም ኃጢአትን እንዲያስወግድ የማይቻል ነውና።

verses.en: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi Christ, entrant dans le monde, dit: Tu n''as voulu ni sacrifice ni offrande, Mais tu m''as formé un corps;
verses.am: ስለዚህ ወደ ዓለም ሲገባ። መሥዋዕትንና መባን አልወደድህም ሥጋን ግን አዘጋጀህልኝ፤

verses.en: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.
verses.fr: Tu n''as agréé ni holocaustes ni sacrifices pour le péché.
verses.am: በሙሉ በሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ሰለ ኃጢአት በሚሰዋ መሥዋዕት ደስ አላለህም።

verses.en: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.
verses.fr: Alors j''ai dit: Voici, je viens Dans le rouleau du livre il est question de moi Pour faire, ô Dieu, ta volonté.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ። እነሆ፥ በመጽሐፍ ጥቅልል ስለ እኔ እንደ ተጻፈ፥ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ፈቃድህን ላደርግ መጥቼአለሁ አልሁ

verses.en: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;
verses.fr: Après avoir dit d''abord: Tu n''as voulu et tu n''as agréé ni sacrifices ni offrandes, Ni holocaustes ni sacrifices pour le péché ce qu''on offre selon la loi,
verses.am: ይላል። በዚህ ላይ። መሥዋዕትንና መባን በሙሉ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትንም ስለ ኃጢአትም የሚሰዋ መሥዋዕትን አልወደድህም በእርሱም ደስ አላለህም ብሎ፥ እነዚህም እንደ ሕግ የሚቀርቡት ናቸው፥

verses.en: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
verses.fr: il dit ensuite: Voici, je viens Pour faire ta volonté. Il abolit ainsi la première chose pour établir la seconde.
verses.am: ቀጥሎ። እነሆ፥ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ፈቃድህን ላደርግ መጥቼአለሁ ብሎአል። ሁለተኛውንም ሊያቆም የፊተኛውን ይሽራል።

verses.en: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
verses.fr: C''est en vertu de cette volonté que nous sommes sanctifiés, par l''offrande du corps de Jésus-Christ, une fois pour toutes.
verses.am: በዚህም ፈቃድ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ሥጋ አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ በማቅረብ ተቀድሰናል።

verses.en: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
verses.fr: Et tandis que tout sacrificateur fait chaque jour le service et offre souvent les mêmes sacrifices, qui ne peuvent jamais ôter les péchés,
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናትም ሁሉ ዕለት ዕለት እያገለገለ ኃጢአትን ሊያስወግዱ ከቶ የማይችሉትን እነዚያን መሥዋዕቶች ብዙ ጊዜ እያቀረበ ቆሞአል፤

verses.en: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;
verses.fr: lui, après avoir offert un seul sacrifice pour les péchés, s''est assis pour toujours à la droite de Dieu,
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ስለ ኃጢአት አንድን መሥዋዕት ለዘላለም አቅርቦ በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ተቀመጠ፥

verses.en: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
verses.fr: attendant désormais que ses ennemis soient devenus son marchepied.
verses.am: ጠላቶቹም የእግሩ መረገጫ እስኪደረጉ ድረስ ወደ ፊት ይጠብቃል።

verses.en: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
verses.fr: Car, par une seule offrande, il a amené à la perfection pour toujours ceux qui sont sanctifiés.
verses.am: አንድ ጊዜ በማቅረብ የሚቀደሱትን የዘላለም ፍጹማን አድርጎአቸዋልና።

verses.en: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
verses.fr: C''est ce que le Saint-Esprit nous atteste aussi; car, après avoir dit:
verses.am: ብሎ ከተናገረ በኋላ፥ ኃጢአታቸውንና ዓመጻቸውንም ደግሜ አላስብም ይላል።

verses.en: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
verses.fr: Voici l''alliance que je ferai avec eux, Après ces jours-là, dit le Seigneur: Je mettrai mes lois dans leurs coeurs, Et je les écrirai dans leur esprit, il ajoute:
verses.am: ብሎ ከተናገረ በኋላ፥ ኃጢአታቸውንና ዓመጻቸውንም ደግሜ አላስብም ይላል።

verses.en: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.fr: Et je ne me souviendrai plus de leurs péchés ni de leurs iniquités.
verses.am: የእነዚህም ስርየት ባለበት ዘንድ፥ ከዚህ ወዲህ ስለ ኃጢአት ማቅረብ የለም።

verses.en: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
verses.fr: Or, là où il y a pardon des péchés, il n''y a plus d''offrande pour le péché.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ላይ የሆነ ታላቅ ካህን ስላለን፥

verses.en: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
verses.fr: Ainsi donc, frères, puisque nous avons, au moyen du sang de Jésus, une libre entrée dans le sanctuaire
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ላይ የሆነ ታላቅ ካህን ስላለን፥

verses.en: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
verses.fr: par la route nouvelle et vivante qu''il a inaugurée pour nous au travers du voile, c''est-à-dire, de sa chair,
verses.am: ከክፉ ሕሊና ለመንጻት ልባችንን ተረጭተን ሰውነታችንንም በጥሩ ውኃ ታጥበን በተረዳንበት እምነት በቅን ልብ እንቅረብ፤

verses.en: And having an high priest over the house of God;
verses.fr: et puisque nous avons un souverain sacrificateur établi sur la maison de Dieu,
verses.am: የተስፋን ቃል የሰጠው የታመነ ነውና እንዳይነቃነቅ የተስፋችንን ምስክርነት እንጠብቅ፤

verses.en: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
verses.fr: approchons-nous avec un coeur sincère, dans la plénitude de la foi, les coeurs purifiés d''une mauvaise conscience, et le corps lavé d''une eau pure.
verses.am: ለፍቅርና ለመልካምም ሥራ እንድንነቃቃ እርስ በርሳችን እንተያይ፤

verses.en: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
verses.fr: Retenons fermement la profession de notre espérance, car celui qui a fait la promesse est fidèle.
verses.am: በአንዳንዶችም ዘንድ ልማድ እንደ ሆነው፥ መሰብሰባችንን አንተው እርስ በርሳችን እንመካከር እንጂ፤ ይልቁንም ቀኑ ሲቀርብ እያያችሁ አብልጣችሁ ይህን አድርጉ።

verses.en: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
verses.fr: Veillons les uns sur les autres, pour nous exciter à la charité et aux bonnes oeuvres.
verses.am: የእውነትን እውቀት ከተቀበልን በኋላ ወደን ኃጢአት ብናደርግ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አይቀርልንምና፥

verses.en: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
verses.fr: N''abandonnons pas notre assemblée, comme c''est la coutume de quelques-uns; mais exhortons-nous réciproquement, et cela d''autant plus que vous voyez s''approcher le jour.
verses.am: የሚያስፈራ ግን የፍርድ መጠበቅ ተቃዋሚዎችንም ሊበላ ያለው የእሳት ብርታት አለ።

verses.en: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
verses.fr: Car, si nous péchons volontairement après avoir reçu la connaissance de la vérité, il ne reste plus de sacrifice pour les péchés,
verses.am: የሙሴን ሕግ የናቀ ሰው ሁለት ወይም ሦስት ቢመሰክሩበት ያለ ርኅራኄ ይሞታል፤

verses.en: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
verses.fr: mais une attente terrible du jugement et l''ardeur d''un feu qui dévorera les rebelles.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ልጅ የረገጠ ያንንም የተቀደሰበትን የኪዳኑን ደም እንደ ርኵስ ነገር የቆጠረ የጸጋውንም መንፈስ ያክፋፋ፥ እንዴት ይልቅ የሚብስ ቅጣት የሚገባው ይመስላችኋል?

verses.en: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
verses.fr: Celui qui a violé la loi de Moïse meurt sans miséricorde, sur la déposition de deux ou de trois témoins;
verses.am: በቀል የእኔ ነው፥ እኔ ብድራትን እመልሳለሁ ያለውን እናውቃለንና፤ ደግሞም። ጌታ በሕዝቡ ይፈርዳል።

verses.en: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
verses.fr: de quel pire châtiment pensez-vous que sera jugé digne celui qui aura foulé aux pieds le Fils de Dieu, qui aura tenu pour profane le sang de l''alliance, par lequel il a été sanctifié, et qui aura outragé l''Esprit de la grâce?
verses.am: በሕያው እግዚአብሔር እጅ መውደቅ የሚያስፈራ ነው።

verses.en: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
verses.fr: Car nous connaissons celui qui a dit: A moi la vengeance, à moi la rétribution! et encore: Le Seigneur jugera son peuple.
verses.am: የሚበልጥና ለዘወትር የሚኖር ገንዘብ በሰማይ ራሳችሁ እንዳላችሁ አውቃችሁ፥ በእስራቴ ራራችሁልኝ የገንዘባችሁንም ንጥቂያ በደስታ ተቀበላችሁ።

verses.en: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verses.fr: C''est une chose terrible que de tomber entre les mains du Dieu vivant.
verses.am: የሚበልጥና ለዘወትር የሚኖር ገንዘብ በሰማይ ራሳችሁ እንዳላችሁ አውቃችሁ፥ በእስራቴ ራራችሁልኝ የገንዘባችሁንም ንጥቂያ በደስታ ተቀበላችሁ።

verses.en: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
verses.fr: Souvenez-vous de ces premiers jours, où, après avoir été éclairés, vous avez soutenu un grand combat au milieu des souffrances,
verses.am: እንግዲህ ታላቅ ብድራት ያለውን ድፍረታችሁን አትጣሉ።

verses.en: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
verses.fr: d''une part, exposés comme en spectacle aux opprobres et aux tribulations, et de l''autre, vous associant à ceux dont la position était la même.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ አድርጋችሁ የተሰጣችሁን የተስፋ ቃል እንድታገኙ መጽናት ያስፈልጋችኋልና።

verses.en: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
verses.fr: En effet, vous avez eu de la compassion pour les prisonniers, et vous avez accepté avec joie l''enlèvement de vos biens, sachant que vous avez des biens meilleurs et qui durent toujours.
verses.am: ገና በጣም ጥቂት ጊዜ ነው፥ ሊመጣ ያለውም ይመጣል አይዘገይምም፤

verses.en: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
verses.fr: N''abandonnez donc pas votre assurance, à laquelle est attachée une grande rémunération.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ግን በእምነት ይኖራል ወደ ኋላም ቢያፈገፍግ፥ ነፍሴ በእርሱ ደስ አይላትም።

verses.en: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
verses.fr: Car vous avez besoin de persévérance, afin qu''après avoir accompli la volonté de Dieu, vous obteniez ce qui vous est promis.
verses.am: እኛ ግን ነፍሳቸውን ሊያድኑ ከሚያምኑቱ ነን እንጂ ወደ ጥፋት ከሚያፈገፍጉ አይደለንም።

verses.en: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
verses.fr: Encore un peu, un peu de temps: celui qui doit venir viendra, et il ne tardera pas.
verses.am: ገና በጣም ጥቂት ጊዜ ነው፥ ሊመጣ ያለውም ይመጣል አይዘገይምም፤

verses.en: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
verses.fr: Et mon juste vivra par la foi; mais, s''il se retire, mon âme ne prend pas plaisir en lui.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ግን በእምነት ይኖራል ወደ ኋላም ቢያፈገፍግ፥ ነፍሴ በእርሱ ደስ አይላትም።

verses.en: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
verses.fr: Nous, nous ne sommes pas de ceux qui se retirent pour se perdre, mais de ceux qui ont la foi pour sauver leur âme.
verses.am: እኛ ግን ነፍሳቸውን ሊያድኑ ከሚያምኑቱ ነን እንጂ ወደ ጥፋት ከሚያፈገፍጉ አይደለንም።

verses.en: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
verses.fr: Or la foi est une ferme assurance des choses qu''on espère, une démonstration de celles qu''on ne voit pas.
verses.am: እምነትም ተስፋ ስለምናደርገው ነገር የሚያስረግጥ፥ የማናየውንም ነገር የሚያስረዳ ነው።

verses.en: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
verses.fr: Pour l''avoir possédée, les anciens ont obtenu un témoignage favorable.
verses.am: ለሽማግሌዎች የተመሰከረላቸው በዚህ ነውና።

verses.en: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi que nous reconnaissons que le monde a été formé par la parole de Dieu, en sorte que ce qu''on voit n''a pas été fait de choses visibles.
verses.am: ዓለሞች በእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንደ ተዘጋጁ፥ ስለዚህም የሚታየው ነገር ከሚታዩት እንዳልሆነ በእምነት እናስተውላለን።

verses.en: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi qu''Abel offrit à Dieu un sacrifice plus excellent que celui de Caïn; c''est par elle qu''il fut déclaré juste, Dieu approuvant ses offrandes; et c''est par elle qu''il parle encore, quoique mort.
verses.am: አቤል ከቃየል ይልቅ የሚበልጥን መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር በእምነት አቀረበ፥ በዚህም፥ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ስጦታው ሲመሰክር፥ እርሱ ጻድቅ እንደ ሆነ ተመሰከረለት፤ ሞቶም ሳለ በመሥዋዕቱ እስከ አሁን ይናገራል።

verses.en: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi qu''Enoch fut enlevé pour qu''il ne vît point la mort, et qu''il ne parut plus parce que Dieu l''avait enlevé; car, avant son enlèvement, il avait reçu le témoignage qu''il était agréable à Dieu.
verses.am: ሄኖክ ሞትን እንዳያይ በእምነት ተወሰደ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ስለ ወሰደው አልተገኘም። ሳይወሰድ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ እንዳሰኘ ተመስክሮለታልና፤

verses.en: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
verses.fr: Or sans la foi il est impossible de lui être agréable; car il faut que celui qui s''approche de Dieu croie que Dieu existe, et qu''il est le rémunérateur de ceux qui le cherchent.
verses.am: ያለ እምነትም ደስ ማሰኘት አይቻልም፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚደርስ እግዚአብሔር እንዳለ ለሚፈልጉትም ዋጋ እንዲሰጥ ያምን ዘንድ ያስፈልገዋልና።

verses.en: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi que Noé, divinement averti des choses qu''on ne voyait pas encore, et saisi d''une crainte respectueuse, construisit une arche pour sauver sa famille; c''est par elle qu''il condamna le monde, et devint héritier de la justice qui s''obtient par la foi.
verses.am: ኖኅ ገና ስለማይታየው ነገር ተረድቶ እግዚአብሔርን እየፈራ ቤተ ስዎቹን ለማዳን መርከብን በእምነት አዘጋጀ፥ በዚህም ዓለምን ኰነነ፥ በእምነትም የሚገኘውን ጽድቅ ወራሽ ሆነ።

verses.en: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi qu''Abraham, lors de sa vocation, obéit et partit pour un lieu qu''il devait recevoir en héritage, et qu''il partit sans savoir où il allait.
verses.am: አብርሃም የተባለው ርስት አድርጎ ሊቀበለው ወዳለው ስፍራ ለመውጣት በእምነት ታዘዘ፥ ወዴትም እንደሚሄድ ሳያውቅ ወጣ።

verses.en: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
verses.fr: C''est par la foi qu''il vint s''établir dans la terre promise comme dans une terre étrangère, habitant sous des tentes, ainsi qu''Isaac et Jacob, les cohéritiers de la même promesse.
verses.am: ለእንግዶች እንደሚሆን በተስፋ ቃል በተሰጠው አገር በድንኳን ኖሮ፥ ያን የተስፋ ቃል አብረውት ከሚወርሱ ከይስሐቅና ከያዕቆብ ጋር፥ እንደ መጻተኛ በእምነት ተቀመጠ፤

verses.en: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
verses.fr: Car il attendait la cité qui a de solides fondements, celle dont Dieu est l''architecte et le constructeur.
verses.am: መሠረት ያላትን፥ እግዚአብሔር የሠራትንና የፈጠራትን ከተማ ይጠብቅ ነበርና።

verses.en: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi que Sara elle-même, malgré son âge avancé, fut rendue capable d''avoir une postérité, parce qu''elle crut à la fidélité de celui qui avait fait la promesse.
verses.am: ተስፋ የሰጠው የታመነ እንደ ሆነ ስለ ቈጠረች፥ ሣራ ራስዋ ደግሞ ዕድሜዋ እንኳ ካለፈ በኋላ ዘርን ለመፅነስ ኃይልን በእምነት አገኘች።

verses.en: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi d''un seul homme, déjà usé de corps, naquit une postérité nombreuse comme les étoiles du ciel, comme le sable qui est sur le bord de la mer et qu''on ne peut compter.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ደግሞ በብዛታቸው እንደ ሰማይ ኮከብ እንደማይቈጠርም በባሕር ዳር እንዳለ አሸዋ የነበሩት የሞተን ሰው እንኳ ከመሰለው ከአንዱ ተወለዱ።
