verses.en: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
verses.fr: C''est dans la foi qu''ils sont tous morts, sans avoir obtenu les choses promises; mais ils les ont vues et saluées de loin, reconnaissant qu''ils étaient étrangers et voyageurs sur la terre.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ አምነው ሞቱ፥ የተሰጣቸውን የተስፋ ቃል አላገኙምና፤ ዳሩ ግን ከሩቅ ሆነው አዩትና ተሳለሙት፥ በምድሪቱም እንግዶችና መጻተኞች እንዲሆኑ ታመኑ።

verses.en: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
verses.fr: Ceux qui parlent ainsi montrent qu''ils cherchent une patrie.
verses.am: እንዲህ የሚሉት ለእነርሱ የሚሆነውን አገር እንዲፈልጉ ያመለክታሉና።

verses.en: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
verses.fr: S''ils avaient eu en vue celle d''où ils étaient sortis, ils auraient eu le temps d''y retourner.
verses.am: ያን የወጡበትን አገር አስበው ቢሆኑ፥ ሊመለሱ ጊዜ በሆነላቸው ነበር፤

verses.en: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
verses.fr: Mais maintenant ils en désirent une meilleure, c''est-à-dire une céleste. C''est pourquoi Dieu n''a pas honte d''être appelé leur Dieu, car il leur a préparé une cité.
verses.am: አሁን ግን የሚበልጠውን እርሱም ሰማያዊ አገር ይናፍቃሉ። ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር አምላካቸው ተብሎ ሊጠራ በእነርሱ አያፍርም፥ ከተማን አዘጋጅቶላቸዋልና።

verses.en: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
verses.fr: C''est par la foi qu''Abraham offrit Isaac, lorsqu''il fut mis à l''épreuve, et qu''il offrit son fils unique, lui qui avait reçu les promesses,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከሙታን እንኳ ሊያስነሣው እንዲቻለው አስቦአልና፥ ከዚያም ደግሞ በምሳሌ አገኘው።

verses.en: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:
verses.fr: et à qui il avait été dit: En Isaac sera nommée pour toi une postérité.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከሙታን እንኳ ሊያስነሣው እንዲቻለው አስቦአልና፥ ከዚያም ደግሞ በምሳሌ አገኘው።

verses.en: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
verses.fr: Il pensait que Dieu est puissant, même pour ressusciter les morts; aussi le recouvra-t-il par une sorte de résurrection.
verses.am: ይስሐቅ ሊመጣ ስላለው ነገር ያዕቆብንና ዔሳውን በእምነት ባረካቸው።

verses.en: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi qu''Isaac bénit Jacob et Esaü, en vue des choses à venir.
verses.am: ያዕቆብ ሲሞት በእምነት የዮሴፍን ልጆች እያንዳንዳቸው ባረካቸው፥ በዘንጉም ጫፍ ተጠግቶ ሰገደ።

verses.en: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi que Jacob mourant bénit chacun des fils de Joseph, et qu''il adora, appuyé sur l''extrémité de son bâton.
verses.am: ዮሴፍ ወደ ሞት ቀርቦ ሳለ በእምነት ስለ እስራኤል ልጆች መውጣት አስታወሰ፥ ስለ አጥንቱም አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi que Joseph mourant fit mention de la sortie des fils d''Israël, et qu''il donna des ordres au sujet de ses os.
verses.am: ሙሴ ከተወለደ በኋላ ወላጆቹ ያማረ ሕፃን መሆኑን አይተው በእምነት ሦስት ወር ሸሸጉት የንጉሥንም አዋጅ አልፈሩም።

verses.en: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi que Moïse, à sa naissance, fut caché pendant trois mois par ses parents, parce qu''ils virent que l''enfant était beau, et qu''ils ne craignirent pas l''ordre du roi.
verses.am: ሙሴ ካደገ በኋላ የፈርዖን የልጅ ልጅ እንዳይባል በእምነት እምቢ አለ፤

verses.en: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
verses.fr: C''est par la foi que Moïse, devenu grand, refusa d''être appelé fils de la fille de Pharaon,
verses.am: የንጉሡን ቍጣ ሳይፈራ የግብፅን አገር የተወ በእምነት ነበር፤ የማይታየውን እንደሚያየው አድርጎ ጸንቶአልና።

verses.en: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
verses.fr: aimant mieux être maltraité avec le peuple de Dieu que d''avoir pour un temps la jouissance du péché,
verses.am: የንጉሡን ቍጣ ሳይፈራ የግብፅን አገር የተወ በእምነት ነበር፤ የማይታየውን እንደሚያየው አድርጎ ጸንቶአልና።

verses.en: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
verses.fr: regardant l''opprobre de Christ comme une richesse plus grande que les trésors de l''Egypte, car il avait les yeux fixés sur la rémunération.
verses.am: አጥፊው የበኵሮችን ልጆች እንዳይነካ ፋሲካንና ደምን መርጨትን በእምነት አደረገ።

verses.en: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi qu''il quitta l''Egypte, sans être effrayé de la colère du roi; car il se montra ferme, comme voyant celui qui est invisible.
verses.am: በደረቅ ምድር እንደሚያልፉ በኤርትራ ባሕር በእምነት ተሻገሩ፥ የግብፅ ሰዎች ግን ሲሞክሩ ተዋጡ።

verses.en: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi qu''il fit la Pâque et l''aspersion du sang, afin que l''exterminateur ne touchât pas aux premiers-nés des Israélites.
verses.am: የኢያሪኮ ቅጥር ሰባት ቀን ከዞሩበት በኋላ በእምነት ወደቀ።

verses.en: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi qu''ils traversèrent la mer Rouge comme un lieu sec, tandis que les Egyptiens qui en firent la tentative furent engloutis.
verses.am: ጋለሞታይቱ ረዓብ ሰላዮችን በሰላም ስለ ተቀበለቻቸው ከማይታዘዙ ጋር በእምነት አልጠፋችም።

verses.en: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi que les murailles de Jéricho tombèrent, après qu''on en eut fait le tour pendant sept jours.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምን እላለሁ? ስለ ጌዴዎንና ስለ ባርቅ ስለ ሶምሶንም ስለ ዮፍታሔም ስለ ዳዊትና ስለ ሳሙኤልም ስለ ነቢያትም እንዳልተርክ ጊዜ ያጥርብኛልና።

verses.en: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi que Rahab la prostituée ne périt pas avec les rebelles, parce qu''elle avait reçu les espions avec bienveillance.
verses.am: እነርሱ በእምነት መንግሥታትን ድል ነሡ፥ ጽድቅን አደረጉ፥ የተሰጠውን የተስፋ ቃል አገኙ፥

verses.en: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
verses.fr: Et que dirai-je encore? Car le temps me manquerait pour parler de Gédéon, de Barak, de Samson, de Jephthé, de David, de Samuel, et des prophètes,
verses.am: የአንበሶችን አፍ ዘጉ፥ የእሳትን ኃይል አጠፉ፥ ከሰይፍ ስለት አመለጡ፥ ከድካማቸው በረቱ፥ በጦርነት ኃይለኞች ሆኑ፥ የባዕድ ጭፍሮችን አባረሩ።

verses.en: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions.
verses.fr: qui, par la foi, vainquirent des royaumes, exercèrent la justice, obtinrent des promesses, fermèrent la gueule des lions,
verses.am: ሴቶች ሙታናቸውን በትንሣኤ ተቀበሉ፤ ሌሎችም መዳንን ሳይቀበሉ የሚበልጠውን ትንሣኤ እንዲያገኙ እስከ ሞት ድረስ ተደበደቡ፤

verses.en: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
verses.fr: teignirent la puissance du feu, échappèrent au tranchant de l''épée, guérirent de leurs maladies, furent vaillants à la guerre, mirent en fuite des armées étrangères.
verses.am: ሌሎችም መዘበቻ በመሆንና በመገረፍ ከዚህም በላይ በእስራትና በወኅኒ ተፈተኑ፤

verses.en: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
verses.fr: Des femmes recouvrèrent leurs morts par la résurrection; d''autres furent livrés aux tourments, et n''acceptèrent point de délivrance, afin d''obtenir une meilleure résurrection;
verses.am: በድንጋይ ተወግረው ሞቱ፥ ተፈተኑ፥ በመጋዝ ተሰነጠቁ፥ በሰይፍ ተገድለው ሞቱ፥ ሁሉን እያጡ መከራን እየተቀበሉ እየተጨነቁ የበግና የፍየል ሌጦ ለብሰው ዞሩ፤

verses.en: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
verses.fr: d''autres subirent les moqueries et le fouet, les chaînes et la prison;
verses.am: ዓለም አልተገባቸውምና በምድረ በዳና በተራራ፥ በዋሻና በምድር ጕድጓድ ተቅበዘበዙ።

verses.en: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
verses.fr: ils furent lapidés, sciés, torturés, ils moururent tués par l''épée, ils allèrent çà et là vêtus de peaux de brebis et de peaux de chèvres, dénués de tout, persécutés, maltraités,
verses.am: በድንጋይ ተወግረው ሞቱ፥ ተፈተኑ፥ በመጋዝ ተሰነጠቁ፥ በሰይፍ ተገድለው ሞቱ፥ ሁሉን እያጡ መከራን እየተቀበሉ እየተጨነቁ የበግና የፍየል ሌጦ ለብሰው ዞሩ፤

verses.en: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
verses.fr: eux dont le monde n''était pas digne, errants dans les déserts et les montagnes, dans les cavernes et les antres de la terre.
verses.am: ዓለም አልተገባቸውምና በምድረ በዳና በተራራ፥ በዋሻና በምድር ጕድጓድ ተቅበዘበዙ።

verses.en: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
verses.fr: Tous ceux-là, à la foi desquels il a été rendu témoignage, n''ont pas obtenu ce qui leur était promis,

verses.en: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
verses.fr: Dieu ayant en vue quelque chose de meilleur pour nous, afin qu''ils ne parvinssent pas sans nous à la perfection.
verses.am: እነዚህም ሁሉ በእምነታቸው ተመስክሮላቸው ሳሉ የተሰጠውን የተስፋ ቃል አላገኙም፥ ያለ እኛ ፍጹማን እንዳይሆኑ እግዚአብሔር ስለ እኛ አንዳች የሚበልጥ ነገርን አስቀድሞ አይቶ ነበርና።

verses.en: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
verses.fr: Nous donc aussi, puisque nous sommes environnés d''une si grande nuée de témoins, rejetons tout fardeau, et le péché qui nous enveloppe si facilement, et courons avec persévérance dans la carrière qui nous est ouverte,
verses.am: እንግዲህ እነዚህን የሚያህሉ ምስክሮች እንደ ደመና በዙሪያችን ካሉልን፥

verses.en: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.fr: ayant les regards sur Jésus, le chef et le consommateur de la foi, qui, en vue de la joie qui lui était réservée, a souffert la croix, méprisé l''ignominie, et s''est assis à la droite du trône de Dieu.
verses.am: እኛ ደግሞ ሸክምን ሁሉ ቶሎም የሚከበንን ኃጢአት አስወግደን፥ የእምነታችንንም ራስና ፈጻሚውን ኢየሱስን ተመልክተን፥ በፊታችን ያለውን ሩጫ በትዕግሥት እንሩጥ፤ እርሱ ነውርን ንቆ በፊቱም ስላለው ደስታ በመስቀል ታግሦ በእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ቀኝ ተቀምጦአልና።

verses.en: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
verses.fr: Considérez, en effet, celui qui a supporté contre sa personne une telle opposition de la part des pécheurs, afin que vous ne vous lassiez point, l''âme découragée.
verses.am: በነፍሳችሁ ዝላችሁ እንዳትደክሙ፥ ከኃጢአተኞች በደረሰበት እንዲህ ባለ መቃወም የጸናውን አስቡ።

verses.en: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
verses.fr: Vous n''avez pas encore résisté jusqu''au sang, en luttant contre le péché.
verses.am: ከኃጢአት ጋር እየተጋደላችሁ ገና ደምን እስከ ማፍሰስ ድረስ አልተቃወማችሁም፤

verses.en: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
verses.fr: Et vous avez oublié l''exhortation qui vous est adressée comme à des fils: Mon fils, ne méprise pas le châtiment du Seigneur, Et ne perds pas courage lorsqu''il te reprend;

verses.en: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
verses.fr: Car le Seigneur châtie celui qu''il aime, Et il frappe de la verge tous ceux qu''il reconnaît pour ses fils.
verses.am: እንደ ልጆችም ከእናንተ ጋር። ልጄ ሆይ፥ የጌታን ቅጣት አታቅልል፥ በሚገሥጽህም ጊዜ አትድከም፤ ጌታ የሚወደውን ይቀጣዋልና፥ የሚቀበለውንም ልጅ ሁሉ ይገርፈዋል ብሎ የሚነጋገረውን ምክር ረስታችኋል።

verses.en: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
verses.fr: Supportez le châtiment: c''est comme des fils que Dieu vous traite; car quel est le fils qu''un père ne châtie pas?
verses.am: ለመቀጣት ታገሡ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ልጆች ያደርግላችኋልና፤ አባቱ የማይቀጣው ልጅ ማን ነው?

verses.en: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
verses.fr: Mais si vous êtes exempts du châtiment auquel tous ont part, vous êtes donc des enfants illégitimes, et non des fils.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሁሉ የቅጣት ተካፋይ ሆኖአልና ያለ ቅጣት ብትኖሩ ዲቃላዎች እንጂ ልጆች አይደላችሁም።

verses.en: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
verses.fr: D''ailleurs, puisque nos pères selon la chair nous ont châtiés, et que nous les avons respectés, ne devons-nous pas à bien plus forte raison nous soumettre au Père des esprits, pour avoir la vie?
verses.am: ከዚህም በላይ የቀጡን የሥጋችን አባቶች ነበሩን እናፍራቸውም ነበር፤ እንዴትስ ይልቅ ለመናፍስት አባት አብልጠን ልንገዛና በሕይወት ልንኖር በተገባን?

verses.en: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
verses.fr: Nos pères nous châtiaient pour peu de jours, comme ils le trouvaient bon; mais Dieu nous châtie pour notre bien, afin que nous participions à sa sainteté.
verses.am: እነርሱ መልካም ሆኖ እንደ ታያቸው ለጥቂት ቀን ይቀጡን ነበርና፥ እርሱ ግን ከቅድስናው እንድንካፈል ለጥቅማችን ይቀጣናል።

verses.en: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
verses.fr: Il est vrai que tout châtiment semble d''abord un sujet de tristesse, et non de joie; mais il produit plus tard pour ceux qui ont été ainsi exercés un fruit paisible de justice.
verses.am: ቅጣት ሁሉ ለጊዜው የሚያሳዝን እንጂ ደስ የሚያሰኝ አይመስልም፥ ዳሩ ግን በኋላ ለለመዱት የሰላምን ፍሬ እርሱም ጽድቅን ያፈራላቸዋል።

verses.en: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
verses.fr: Fortifiez donc vos mains languissantes Et vos genoux affaiblis;
verses.am: ስለዚህ የላሉትን እጆች የሰለሉትንም ጉልበቶች አቅኑ፤

verses.en: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
verses.fr: et suivez avec vos pieds des voies droites, afin que ce qui est boiteux ne dévie pas, mais plutôt se raffermisse.
verses.am: ያነከሰውም እንዲፈወስ እንጂ እንዳይናጋ፥ ለእግራችሁ ቅን መንገድ አድርጉ።

verses.en: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
verses.fr: Recherchez la paix avec tous, et la sanctification, sans laquelle personne ne verra le Seigneur.
verses.am: ከሰው ሁሉ ጋር ሰላምን ተከታተሉ ትቀደሱም ዘንድ ፈልጉ፥ ያለ እርሱ ጌታን ሊያይ የሚችል የለምና።

verses.en: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
verses.fr: Veillez à ce que nul ne se prive de la grâce de Dieu; à ce qu''aucune racine d''amertume, poussant des rejetons, ne produise du trouble, et que plusieurs n''en soient infectés;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ለማንም እንዳይጎድለው፥ ብዙዎቹም የሚረክሱበት አንድ መራራ ሥር ወደ ላይ በቅሎ እንዳያስጨንቅ፥ ሴሰኛም የሚሆን እንዳይገኝ፥

verses.en: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
verses.fr: ce qu''il n''y ait ni impudique, ni profane comme Esaü, qui pour un mets vendit son droit d''aînesse.
verses.am: ወይም ስለ አንድ መብል በኵርነቱን እንደ ሸጠ እንደ ዔሳው ለዚህ ዓለም የሚመች ሰው እንዳይሆን ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
verses.fr: Vous savez que, plus tard, voulant obtenir la bénédiction, il fut rejeté, quoiqu''il la sollicitât avec larmes; car son repentir ne put avoir aucun effet.
verses.am: ከዚያ በኋላ እንኳ በረከቱን ሊወርስ በወደደ ጊዜ እንደ ተጣለ ታውቃላችሁና፤ በእንባ ተግቶ ምንም ቢፈልገው ለንስሐ ስፍራ አላገኘምና።

verses.en: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
verses.fr: Vous ne vous êtes pas approchés d''une montagne qu''on pouvait toucher et qui était embrasée par le feu, ni de la nuée, ni des ténèbres, ni de la tempête,
verses.am: ሊዳሰስ ወደሚችል ወደሚቃጠልም እሳት ወደ ጭጋግም ወደ ጨለማም ወደ ዐውሎ ነፋስም ወደ መለከት ድምፅም ወደ ቃሎችም ነገር አልደረሳችሁምና፤

verses.en: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
verses.fr: ni du retentissement de la trompette, ni du bruit des paroles, tel que ceux qui l''entendirent demandèrent qu''il ne leur en fût adressé aucune de plus,
verses.am: ያንም ነገር የሰሙት ሌላ ቃል እንዳይጨመርባቸው ለመኑ፤

verses.en: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
verses.fr: car ils ne supportaient pas cette déclaration: Si même une bête touche la montagne, elle sera lapidée.
verses.am: እንስሳ እንኳ ተራራውን ቢነካ ተወግሮ ይሙት የምትለውን ትእዛዝ ሊታገሡ አልቻሉምና፤

verses.en: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
verses.fr: Et ce spectacle était si terrible que Moïse dit: Je suis épouvanté et tout tremblant!
verses.am: ሙሴም። እጅግ እፈራለሁ እንቀጠቀጥማለሁ እስኪል ድረስ የሚታየው እጅግ የሚያስፈራ ነበር፤

verses.en: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
verses.fr: Mais vous vous êtes approchés de la montagne de Sion, de la cité du Dieu vivant, la Jérusalem céleste, des myriades qui forment le choeur des anges,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ወደ ጽዮን ተራራና ወደ ሕያው እግዚአብሔር ከተማ ደርሳችኋል፥ ወደ ሰማያዊቱም ኢየሩሳሌም፥ በደስታም ወደ ተሰበሰቡት ወደ አእላፋት መላእክት፥

verses.en: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
verses.fr: de l''assemblée des premiers-nés inscrits dans les cieux, du juge qui est le Dieu de tous, des esprits des justes parvenus à la perfection,
verses.am: በሰማያትም ወደ ተጻፉ ወደ በኵራት ማኅበር፥ የሁሉም ዳኛ ወደሚሆን ወደ እግዚአብሔር፥ ፍጹማንም ወደ ሆኑት ወደ ጻድቃን መንፈሶች፥

verses.en: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
verses.fr: de Jésus qui est le médiateur de la nouvelle alliance, et du sang de l''aspersion qui parle mieux que celui d''Abel.
verses.am: የአዲስም ኪዳን መካከለኛ ወደሚሆን ወደ ኢየሱስ፥ ከአቤልም ደም ይልቅ የሚሻለውን ወደሚናገር ወደ መርጨት ደም ደርሳችኋል።

verses.en: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
verses.fr: Gardez-vous de refuser d''entendre celui qui parle; car si ceux-là n''ont pas échappé qui refusèrent d''entendre celui qui publiait les oracles sur la terre, combien moins échapperons-nous, si nous nous détournons de celui qui parle du haut des cieux,
verses.am: ለሚናገረው እምቢ እንዳትሉ ተጠንቀቁ፤ እነዚያ በምድር ላስረዳቸው እምቢ ባሉ ጊዜ ካላመለጡ፥ ከሰማይ ከመጣው ፈቀቅ የምንል እኛስ እንዴት እናመልጣለን?

verses.en: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
verses.fr: lui, dont la voix alors ébranla la terre, et qui maintenant a fait cette promesse: Une fois encore j''ébranlerai non seulement la terre, mais aussi le ciel.
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ ድምፁ ምድርን አናወጠ፥ አሁን ግን። አንድ ጊዜ ደግሜ እኔ ሰማይን አናውጣለሁ እንጂ ምድርን ብቻ አይደለም ብሎ ተስፋ ሰጥቶአል።

verses.en: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
verses.fr: Ces mots: Une fois encore, indiquent le changement des choses ébranlées, comme étant faites pour un temps, afin que les choses inébranlables subsistent.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን። አንድ ጊዜ ደግሜ የሚል ቃል፥ የማይናወጡት ጸንተው እንዲኖሩ፥ የሚናወጡት የተፈጠሩ እንደሚሆኑ ይለወጡ ዘንድ ያሳያል።

verses.en: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, recevant un royaume inébranlable, montrons notre reconnaissance en rendant à Dieu un culte qui lui soit agréable, avec piété et avec crainte,
verses.am: ስለዚህ የማይናወጥን መንግሥት ስለምንቀበል በማክበርና በፍርሃት እግዚአብሔርን ደስ እያሰኘን የምናመልክበትን ጸጋ እንያዝ፤

verses.en: For our God is a consuming fire.
verses.fr: car notre Dieu est aussi un feu dévorant.
verses.am: አምላካችን በእውነት የሚያጠፋ እሳት ነውና።

verses.en: Let brotherly love continue.
verses.fr: Persévérez dans l''amour fraternel.
verses.am: ወንድማማች መዋደድ ይኑር።

verses.en: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
verses.fr: N''oubliez pas l''hospitalité; car, en l''exerçant, quelques-uns ont logé des anges, sans le savoir.
verses.am: የ እንግዶችን መቀበል አትርሱ፤ በዚህ አንዳንዶች ሳያውቁ መላእክትን እንግድነት ተቀብለዋልና።

verses.en: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
verses.fr: Souvenez-vous des prisonniers, comme si vous étiez aussi prisonniers; de ceux qui sont maltraités, comme étant aussi vous-mêmes dans un corps.
verses.am: ከእነርሱ ጋር እንደ ታሰረ ሆናችሁ እስሮችን አስቡ፥ የተጨነቁትንም ራሳችሁ ደግሞ በሥጋ እንዳለ ሆናችሁ አስቡ።

verses.en: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
verses.fr: Que le mariage soit honoré de tous, et le lit conjugal exempt de souillure, car Dieu jugera les impudiques et les adultères.
verses.am: መጋባት በሁሉ ዘንድ ክቡር መኝታውም ንጹሕ ይሁን፤ ሴሰኞችንና አመንዝሮችን ግን እግዚአብሔር ይፈርድባቸዋል።

verses.en: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.fr: Ne vous livrez pas à l''amour de l''argent; contentez- vous de ce que vous avez; car Dieu lui-même a dit: Je ne te délaisserai point, et je ne t''abandonnerai point.
verses.am: አካሄዳችሁ ገንዘብን ያለ መውደድ ይሁን፥ ያላችሁም ይብቃችሁ፤ እርሱ ራሱ። አልለቅህም ከቶም አልተውህም ብሎአልና፤

verses.en: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
verses.fr: C''est donc avec assurance que nous pouvons dire: Le Seigneur est mon aide, je ne craindrai rien; Que peut me faire un homme?
verses.am: ስለዚህ በድፍረት። ጌታ ይረዳኛልና አልፈራም፤ ሰው ምን ያደርገኛል? እንላለን።

verses.en: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
verses.fr: Souvenez-vous de vos conducteurs qui vous ont annoncé la parole de Dieu; considérez quelle a été la fin de leur vie, et imitez leur foi.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል የተናገሩአችሁን ዋኖቻችሁን አስቡ፥ የኑሮአቸውንም ፍሬ እየተመለከታችሁ በእምነታቸው ምሰሉአቸው።

verses.en: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
verses.fr: Jésus-Christ est le même hier, aujourd''hui, et éternellement.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ትናንትና ዛሬ እስከ ለዘላለምም ያው ነው።

verses.en: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
verses.fr: Ne vous laissez pas entraîner par des doctrines diverses et étrangères; car il est bon que le coeur soit affermi par la grâce, et non par des aliments qui n''ont servi de rien à ceux qui s''y sont attachés.
verses.am: ልዩ ልዩ ዓይነት በሆነ በእንግዳ ትምህርት አትወሰዱ፤ ልባችሁ በጸጋ ቢጸና መልካም ነው እንጂ በመብል አይደለም፤ በዚህ የሚሠሩባት አልተጠቀሙምና።

verses.en: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
verses.fr: Nous avons un autel dont ceux qui font le service au tabernacle n''ont pas le pouvoir de manger.
verses.am: መሠዊያ አለን፥ ከእርሱም ሊበሉ ድንኳኒቱን የሚያገለግሉ መብት የላቸውም።

verses.en: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
verses.fr: Les corps des animaux, dont le sang est porté dans le sanctuaire par le souverain sacrificateur pour le péché, sont brûlés hors du camp.
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናት ስለ ኃጢአት ወደ ቅድስት የእንስሶችን ደም ያቀርባልና፤ ሥጋቸው ግን ከሰፈሩ ውጭ ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
verses.fr: C''est pour cela que Jésus aussi, afin de sanctifier le peuple par son propre sang, a souffert hors de la porte.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ ደግሞ በገዛ ደሙ ሕዝቡን እንዲቀድስ ከበር ውጭ መከራን ተቀበለ።

verses.en: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
verses.fr: Sortons donc pour aller à lui, hors du camp, en portant son opprobre.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ነቀፌታውን እየተሸከምን ወደ እርሱ ወደ ሰፈሩ ውጭ እንውጣ፤

verses.en: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
verses.fr: Car nous n''avons point ici-bas de cité permanente, mais nous cherchons celle qui est à venir.
verses.am: በዚህ የምትኖር ከተማ የለችንምና፥ ነገር ግን ትመጣ ዘንድ ያላትን እንፈልጋለን።

verses.en: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
verses.fr: Par lui, offrons sans cesse à Dieu un sacrifice de louange, c''est-à-dire le fruit de lèvres qui confessent son nom.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ዘወትር ለእግዚአብሔር የምስጋናን መሥዋዕት፥ ማለት ለስሙ የሚመሰክሩ የከንፈሮችን ፍሬ፥ በእርሱ እናቅርብለት።

verses.en: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
verses.fr: Et n''oubliez pas la bienfaisance et la libéralité, car c''est à de tels sacrifices que Dieu prend plaisir.
verses.am: ነገር ግን መልካም ማድረግን ለሌሎችም ማካፈልን አትርሱ፤ እንዲህ ያለው መሥዋዕት እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ያሰኘዋልና።

verses.en: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
verses.fr: Obéissez à vos conducteurs et ayez pour eux de la déférence, car ils veillent sur vos âmes comme devant en rendre compte; qu''il en soit ainsi, afin qu''ils le fassent avec joie, et non en gémissant, ce qui ne vous serait d''aucun avantage.
verses.am: ለዋኖቻችሁ ታዘዙና ተገዙ፤ እነርሱ ስሌትን እንደሚሰጡ አድርገው፥ ይህንኑ በደስታ እንጂ በኃዘን እንዳያደርጉት፥ ይህ የማይጠቅማችሁ ነበርና፥ ስለ ነፍሳችሁ ይተጋሉ።

verses.en: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
verses.fr: Priez pour nous; car nous croyons avoir une bonne conscience, voulant en toutes choses nous bien conduire.
verses.am: ጸልዩልን፤ በነገር ሁሉ በመልካም እንድንኖር ወደን፥ መልካም ሕሊና እንዳለን ተረድተናልና።

verses.en: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
verses.fr: C''est avec instance que je vous demande de le faire, afin que je vous sois rendu plus tôt.
verses.am: ይልቁንም ፈጥኜ እንድመለስላችሁ ይህን ታደርጉ ዘንድ አጥብቄ እለምናችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
verses.fr: Que le Dieu de paix, qui a ramené d''entre les morts le grand pasteur des brebis, par le sang d''une alliance éternelle, notre Seigneur Jésus,
verses.am: በዘላለም ኪዳን ደም ለበጎች ትልቅ እረኛ የሆነውን ጌታችንን ኢየሱስን ከሙታን ያወጣው የሰላም አምላክ፥

verses.en: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.fr: vous rende capables de toute bonne oeuvre pour l''accomplissement de sa volonté, et fasse en vous ce qui lui est agréable, par Jésus-Christ, auquel soit la gloire aux siècles des siècles! Amen!
verses.am: በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በኩል በፊቱ ደስ የሚያሰኘውን በእናንተ እያደረገ፥ ፈቃዱን ታደርጉ ዘንድ በመልካም ሥራ ሁሉ ፍጹማን ያድርጋችሁ፤ ለእርሱ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
verses.fr: Je vous prie, frères, de supporter ces paroles d''exhortation, car je vous ai écrit brièvement.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ የምክርን ቃል እንድትታገሡ እመክራችኋለሁ፥ በጥቂት ቃል ጽፌላችኋለሁና።

verses.en: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
verses.fr: Sachez que notre frère Timothée a été relâché; s''il vient bientôt, j''irai vous voir avec lui.
verses.am: ወንድማችን ጢሞቴዎስ እንደ ተፈታ እወቁ፥ ቶሎ ብሎም ቢመጣ ከእርሱ ጋር አያችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
verses.fr: Saluez tous vos conducteurs, et tous les saints. Ceux d''Italie vous saluent.
verses.am: ለዋኖቻችሁ ሁሉና ለቅዱሳን ሁሉ ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ። ከኢጣልያ የሆኑቱ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል።

verses.en: Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.fr: Que la grâce soit avec vous tous! Amen!
verses.am: ጸጋ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።
